Friends,
If you're like my family, you're getting ready to enjoy the beginning of summer, spending time outside with family and friends.
You're working during the day and then working hard in the backyard on the weekend, hauling kids to soccer and birthday parties, grilling out, and spending precious time out and about—hopefully on the water!
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
That's the lifestyle of Yoopers and Northern Michiganders Bob Lorinser is fighting for — when he refers to our freedoms, families, and futures. It’s about living the life you want and having the ability to do it without working multiple jobs, extensive shifts, or struggling just to make ends meet. . .
Thanks for taking a moment tonight to read this and considering lending your support for that vision. This moment is so important.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.

Friends,
As a second-time challenger, Bob Lorinser has an unprecedented opportunity to defeat Rep. Jack Bergman. Name recognition from campaigning over the last three years with nearly $1 million invested in the district from small-dollar donors give Bob a unique edge to win this November.
Our campaign to help all Northern Michiganders and Yoopers thrive is gaining significant momentum, but we still face an uphill battle.
Our goal is simple: Raise enough money to propel us through the primary election and win in the November general election against the Trump-endorsed Republican Jack Bergman.
With just 60 days until the election and some voters starting to vote later this month , there is no time like the present to get fully engaged as we take the fight to August, then again to November.
Your generous contribution will propel rural Michigan and America forward. Whether you can contribute $10, $25, $50, or even more, every dollar counts and makes a significant impact.
For every $1 raised, we can reach 10 more voters. We're working hard on the ground but must invest in yard signs, mailers, and ads to reach a wider audience and effectively spread Bob's message.
Thank you for your unwavering support and belief in Bob Lorinser's candidacy. Let us make history this November!
Onward!
Kevin Numerick

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. God bless President Trump!

_**During this dark time for our great nation, we must surround President Trump with the LOVE and JOY of our MAGA movement. **_

So we wrote this big, beautiful letter to express our affection and gratitude for all he has done for us and America.

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

Can I tell you something you might not know about me, friend?
While serving as the president of Nevada's largest synagogue, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race and flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that this is how I got into public service – because my Judaism is at the very core**of my work in the Senate today**.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country.

And as we face an increasing number of alarming issues – including growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our very democracy – I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
With early voting already underway in Nevada, The _Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the “most perilous” swing state for Democrats. I’m relying on your support to keep this state blue.

I’m focused on making it easy to vote and hard to cheat because voter participation rises when voters have confidence in elections. | | | | |
---
| I serve as the Chairman of the Committee on House Administration, which has broad oversight of our nation’s federal election law.
I’m focused on making it **easy to vote and hard to cheat** because voter participation rises when voters have confidence in elections.
My latest efforts have focused on banning Bidenbucks from influencing our elections.
**What are Bidenbucks?**
Bidenbucks are taxpayer dollars that Joe Biden has authorized to be used by federal agencies to get-out-the-vote across the country. If left unchecked, taxpayer dollars could be used by partisan federal agencies in voter registration and ultimately influence our elections.
**Taxpayer dollars should never be used for partisan purposes.**
---
[Click Here to Read More About Bidenbucks!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=844b99374e&e=e907534017)
| This week, I sent a letter to the President of the Universities of Wisconsin to ensure federal taxpayer dollars are not being used to fund partisan election efforts on UW campuses.
**Elections are partisan, but election administration should never be partisan.**
Democrats routinely attack me for working to increase confidence in our elections. That’s why they’ve already spent **$2.3 million attacking me on Milwaukee TV.**
This year, our district will be one of the most fiercely contested House races in the country. National Democrats are coming at me more aggressively than they have before and they’re sparing no expense.
If you’re able and willing, I would appreciate your help countering their attacks by donating to my campaign.

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: The significance of this day
body:
June 6 is a significant day for many reasons. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/620094ebf66a/its-official-690?e=ad9732c88c)
---
[](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=9daa3c87b2&e=ad9732c88c)
| Hi Peter,
June 6 is a significant day for many reasons... the first being D-Day.
**It was a day when “ordinary” men and women became extraordinary heroes.**
It was a day when freedom, humanity, and peace were restored by the brave troops who stormed the shores. And it was a day when a generation plagued by world wars and economic devastation _answered the call to serve_ ... and, in turn, _saved the world_.
From the depths of the Great Depression rose the Greatest Generation.
**As French President Emmanuel Macron said to our incredible WWII veterans today: “You left everything and risked everything for our independence, for our freedom. That we will never forget.”**
Their brave actions proved that good can trump evil when “ordinary” Americans come together to fight for what is right. They risked it all to serve and save people they didn’t even know...
[**Because when our freedom, security, and peace are on the line, NOTHING else matters.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=0697029e71&e=ad9732c88c)
_"At the core, the American citizen soldiers knew the difference between right and wrong, and they didn't want to live in a world in which wrong prevailed. So they fought, and won, and we, all of us, living and yet to be born, must be forever profoundly grateful." - Stephen Ambrose, WWII historian, author, and museum founder_
**To our Greatest Generation and all who have served: thank you will never be enough.**
There are so many parallels between those trying times and what we are experiencing today. The only way we’ll fix this is if more patriots answer the call to serve... and are brave enough to _put principles over politics_.
[**That is why this day is also significant to me. This time last year, I got in the race for Congress.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=55c93913ee&e=ad9732c88c)
I didn’t get into this seeking power or prominence. I got in because I felt **called to serve and represent** not only the people of Kansas’ 3rd congressional district, but also the everyday Americans who _don’t feel heard or respected in this political climate_.
My entire life has been defined by my commitment to community, church, and country. I’m not a politician, and I’m not backed by powerful special interest groups or DC power players.
[**I’m just an “ordinary” citizen who was concerned about our country... and decided to do something about it.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=c95a78db3f&e=ad9732c88c)
This day is also significant because it marks **2 months until the Kansas primary election**. And in a race this consequential, **every day, every dollar, and every effort matters**.
Since I’ve entered the race, I’ve attended over 1,000 events and meetings and knocked on thousands of doors. My competitor may try to outraise me, but he will never, _ever_ outwork me.
_I show up because it matters... and because you deserve to be heard._
This is an R+1 seat, which is political speak for: a rational Republican like me **CAN win** this race in November. But the reality is: I will need more funding to have a fighting chance... so I am calling on you to help me.
[**I hope you will answer the call by donating to my campaign today.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=4dbcf0ba9a&e=ad9732c88c)
Thank you so much,
Karen Crnkovich
---
[Answer the Call](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=4f5ec208f5&e=ad9732c88c)
| P.S. There are many different ways to serve our community and country, including getting involved in an election. I know these are trying times for many people.
So if you would like to contribute in some other way, such as volunteering, [**please sign up on my website**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=62135e89c2&e=ad9732c88c). Thank you, and God bless America.
---
| | | | Emails are one of the best ways we can keep you informed and involved. We appreciate your interest and respect your time. If you no longer wish to receive emails, we would hate to see you go, but you may [unsubscribe](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=bd6c3f0385&t=b&e=ad9732c88c&c=8913abfcff) here.
---
|
---

Dear Peter,
I have built my campaign for President around hope–hope for the broken, the addicted, and for so many Americans who feel hopeless today.
That’s why I am excited to invite you to join me in person for the world premiere of the new documentary film, _Recovering America_.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/recovering-america?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=recovering_america_6_5_24_ra1&n=5)
In _Recovering America_ you will witness the drug addiction crisis up close, you will hear from me about my own challenging road to recovery, and you will see there is a bright hope for tomorrow for those struggling with addiction.
As your next President, I will prioritize solving this crisis.
You see, drug overdoses kill more than 300 Americans every day–mothers, fathers, brothers and sisters, and children–approximately 13 people every hour of every day.
Over 100,000 die each year. Millions more are on the brink of death.
Among people in prison, 70% struggle with mental illness, drug addiction, or both. Young lives are being cut short by lethal drugs like fentanyl and tranq, heartbreaking losses that plague cities and rural communities across the country.
I am convinced that our new, innovative, and ground-breaking ideas can help our nation emerge from this crisis and put us on the road to recovery.
Please consider joining me in Albuquerque, New Mexico for the world premiere of this very important documentary made by members of my campaign staff.
A panel and live discussion with me and other special guests will follow the screening.
The event will go from 2:00-4:30 PM. Doors open at 1:00 PM.
[Together, we can stand up for the forgotten and broken, together we can offer hope, together we can rebuild lives and restore a promising future.](http://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=recovering_america_6_5_24_ra1&n=6)

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: Breaking: Biden intends to sign UN Gun Ban
body:
* * *
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

* * *
|
---
| | | | | | |
---
|

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel for decades.

They’ve been waiting for an anti-gun President, like Joe Biden, to take the White House **so they can launch an all-out effort to ratify it in the U.S. Senate**.

Now, they think they finally see their opportunity to _ram it through_!

But you and I have a chance to stop them cold -- **[as long as we take IMMEDIATE action to help dismantle this dangerous Treaty](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=242qhlv023jt2idaj9y7txgn5og73tcaxhtzx24he8jjk2wfusmqoolfn1u5kcn3m8rfhkvy4hobwtrt4sjnpc0rqsdj9gqush0fdb7f8gfvo0jln244h2m2up0ga07gl8lo58ttd90xcafa3v2lskiy4pbayz6n30y870ck56&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=seppzc)**.

As Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the email below, it’s absolutely critical we act now!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,
**“BIDEN AIMS TO SIGN ON TO UN'S GLOBAL GUN REGISTRATION TREATY.”**
That was the headline in the _Washington Examiner_ shortly after President Biden’s State Department spokesman told international bureaucrats of “the continuing commitment of the United States” to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” during the gun control Conference of State Parties in Geneva, Switzerland.

Just a few weeks later, President Biden himself spoke before the United Nations in New York City, stating: _“We’ll continue to uphold the long-standing rules and norms... Bedrock commitments,**like support for arms control measures** to reduce the risk and enhance transparency.”_ Fellow Patriot, anyone hoping that President Biden wouldn’t use his bully pulpit to RAM the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” down the throats of Americans just got those hopes CRUSHED.

The battle over implementation of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- the crown jewel in the gun grabbers’ designs for the globe -- is about to reach a fever pitch.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=242qhlv023jt2idaj9y7txgn5og73tcaxhd1prvc48lwwl2stm05c89rh9l8wkdsglrre9xbdrccsb98da9num064re8j5vlo8h06skibitjdhtgpzv6nanxlfwdpd65hxpzi28mddll68yaem8b8ywwnpzlzaosepydyy0djr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=seppzc)**!

As you’ll see, this survey insists that your U.S. Senators do everything in their power to oppose the UN “Small Arms Treaty” in the U.S. Senate.

_If there’s anything we’ve learned, it’s that globalists have been telling LIES about the supposed “need’ for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” for years_.

From the beginning, gun grabbers have claimed the purpose of the Treaty is keeping arms out of the hands of terrorists, insurgents, rogue states, and gang members.

But at the very same time the Biden Administration was pledging their support for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty,” they were leaving $83 BILLION in U.S. military weaponry to the Taliban!

They don’t care about keeping guns out of the hands of terrorists.

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of “woke capitalism” is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

name: Justin Donnaruma
subject: Join me in returning Maine to her former Glory
body:
Our state is not doing well. It has fallen from a leader of our country to the bottom of the barrel. It is time to fix it. | | | [View in Browser](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fjustin.donnaruma.us%2Fcampaigns%2Fview-email%2FjItwTeXId9qlJEBx_n3I82wAvrKlYgKsEZSujmVWAHA77uy8t2tzBV75FWd9oIgVkYwRGhoMPK_nDCKWSH08aIjFyEZbtg1vBbOtmCjq_c5_KDjxsQU7gftmsRWMfqJR5bOa7ls8vXa4vpWEDGy8a2VN3HRYZ2Zu0LyA7g%3D%3D%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645%26ss_email_id%3D6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a%26ss_campaign_name%3DJoin%2Bme%2Bin%2Breturning%2BMaine%2Bto%2Bher%2Bformer%2BGlory%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-06-07T11%253A04%253A20Z&w=663a956f9cd4d702dd64d650&c=b_666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645&l=en-US&s=mXFnj3TMQEugPwutG0lHh1g1TKs%3D)
---
[](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fjustin.donnaruma.us%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645%26ss_email_id%3D6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a%26ss_campaign_name%3DJoin%2Bme%2Bin%2Breturning%2BMaine%2Bto%2Bher%2Bformer%2BGlory%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-06-07T11%253A04%253A20Z&w=663a956f9cd4d702dd64d650&c=b_666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645&l=en-US&s=A_l2_aFmPQgosfl1fDRFpQbrS1A%3D)
---
| |
---
Dear Friend,I do not usually send emails this long. But this is a special case... In light of recent lawfare in our country, I have been spurred to take action on behalf of my beloved state. Please consider joining me to bring Maine back to the forefront of our Country. [BeyondVacationland.ME](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.beyondvacationland.me&w=663a956f9cd4d702dd64d650&c=b_666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645&l=en-US&s=Y-yhzLQH18DdvHZQglAzNBwFSeI%3D)
---
The battle between good and evil has never been more apparent. For 50 long years, Maine has been led down a path of corruption, greed, and decay. Our state has become a battlefield where the forces of darkness have taken root, oppressing our families and strangling our economy. It is time to cast out these evildoers and reclaim our state from the grip of despair.
---
"As Maine goes, so goes the nation" was once a proud maxim in United States politics, reflecting our state's historical significance and leadership. Yet, 50 years of Democrat control have plunged us into economic stagnation and decline. In the last four years, the dramatic increase in housing, food, and fuel costs have hit Mainers harder than most, exacerbating our struggles because Maine lacks the good jobs needed to support our families. This is the reality we face, and it is why we must rise and fight to restore Maine's former glory.
---
Picture the scene in your favorite local diner: friends and families gather over coffee, reminiscing about the good old days. The laughter, the shared stories, the sense of belonging. But outside, the cries of our neighbors in distress rise to heaven. The ALICE report shows that 74% of single mothers in Maine are struggling, while our seniors are forced to choose between heating their homes and buying medication. This is not the Maine we know and love.
---
Our state-local tax burden ranks 41st in the nation, a crushing weight that suffocates our economic potential. We are overtaxed, over-regulated, and underrepresented. Our leaders have abandoned us, preferring to line their pockets while Mainers suffer. This is nothing short of a moral crisis.
---
Today is the day to create new "good old days" for our children and grandchildren. I, and a few other stalwart Mainer’s are starting a non-profit to take back our State for the People. **Beyond Vacationland** is that non-profit.**Beyond Vacationland** is a beacon of hope, dedicated to advocating for families and small business, influencing public policy, and engaging in political activities to promote the common good. We are Mainers united by a shared vision of a brighter future, one that aligns with the principles of faith, family, and freedom.
---
**Our Vision is Clear:**
1. **Strengthen Small Business**
* Ease Financial Burden through Tax Incentives to lessen financial strain
* Simplify Business Regulations to make it easier to operate and thrive in Maine
* Support Local Entrepreneurship with resources to start and grow new businesses
* Enhance Access to Capital with state-backed loans and grants
* Promote Workforce Development by investing in training programs and certification paths
2. **Revitalize the Economy**
* Simplify the State Tax Code to attract Fortune 100 company Headquarters
* Cut Regulatory Red Tape that deters new business and growth
* Create Jobs with Financial Security
* Invest in high speed internet and reliable cell service support to support business needs
* Promote Sustainable Energy Solutions to reduce cost and improve reliability
3. **Empower Families**
* Improve school facilities and infrastructure to give our children the education they deserve.
* Provide access to educational alternatives that cater to the unique needs of every child.
* Prioritize affordable childcare to support working parents.
* Use tax incentives to ease the financial burden on families.

---
**Why Your Support Matters** We are at a crossroads. As it says in Ephesians,
> "For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places."
> Eph 6:12 (ESV)
Your contribution to **Beyond Vacationland** will help us combat the forces of darkness that seek to destroy our way of life. As a non-profit 501(c)(4) social welfare organization, we represent your interests and ensure your voice is heard. The momentum for change is growing, and with your support, we can achieve meaningful reform for Maine.
---
**Join Us!** The time is now. Change is not just possible—it is imperative. We’re in this together, and we need your help to make a difference. Your donation is an investment in Maine's future. Visit [BeyondVacationland.ME](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a&u=http%3A%2F%2Fbeyondvacationland.me%2F&w=663a956f9cd4d702dd64d650&c=b_666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645&l=en-US&s=i2d7a72oMPZL7m2JXb_LkwVW4Ww%3D "http://BeyondVacationland.ME") to make your contribution today. Every dollar brings us closer to our goals and ensures that Maine thrives. Your support will have a significant impact on our efforts.Thank you for standing with us. Together, we can transform Maine and drive out the forces of darkness with the light of faith and freedom.Best regards,Justin Donnaruma
President - **Beyond Vacationland**
---
[_ _ INVEST NOW!_ _](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6662e8b89c83cb6211f4cf2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.beyondvacationland.me%2Fdonate&w=663a956f9cd4d702dd64d650&c=b_666227c7e9b1cc76fae5e645&l=en-US&s=GvPo0zYV9ttfYmX0qnndXqAHCTI%3D)
---
|
---
**How can you help?**
* Share our message and website with your friends, and on your social media
* Sign up for the Beyond Vacationland Newsletter to keep up with what we are working on, and use our resources to help us fight for Maine.
* Invest in our mission.

https://www.beyondvacationland.me
---
|

Strengthen Small Business Ease Financial Burden through Tax Incentives to lessen financial strain Simplify Business Regulations to make it easier to operate and thrive in Maine Support Local Entrepreneurship with resources to start and grow new businesses Enhance Access to Capital with state-backed loans and grants Promote Workforce Development by investing in training programs and certification paths 2. Revitalize the Economy Simplify the State Tax Code to attract Fortune 100 company Headquarters Cut Regulatory Red Tape that deters new business and growth Create Jobs with Financial Security Invest in high speed internet and reliable cell service support to support business needs Promote Sustainable Energy Solutions to reduce cost and improve reliability 3. Empower Families Improve school facilities and infrastructure to give our children the education they deserve. Provide access to educational alternatives that cater to the unique needs of every child. Prioritize affordable childcare to support working parents. Use tax incentives to ease the financial burden on families. Why Your Support Matters We are at a crossroads. As it says in Ephesians, "For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places." Eph 6:12 (ESV) Your contribution to Beyond Vacationland will help us combat the forces of darkness that seek to destroy our way of life. As a non-profit 501(c)(4) social welfare organization, we represent your interests and ensure your voice is heard. The momentum for change is growing, and with your support, we can achieve meaningful reform for Maine. Join Us! The time is now. Change is not just possible—it is imperative. We’re in this together, and we need your help to make a difference. Your donation is an investment in Maine's future. Visit "" to make your contribution today. Every dollar brings us closer to our goals and ensures that Maine thrives. Your support will have a significant impact on our efforts.Thank you for standing with us. name: Ted Cruz
subject: This email breaks a lot of the rules
body:
I'd like to break the rules.

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvq7fkeqenkceh2in96se3tv0on2l5908giri08o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)
Urgent message from Senator Ted Cruz

Friend,

Please forgive me for sending you a long email.

But it’s about a dire situation in our education system -- from preschools to universities. In my book, _Unwoke_ , I detail what is happening in our schools:
* Children as young as pre-K are taught racial division.
* Radical school teachers are transitioning kids behind the backs of parents.
* Universities are forcing all faculty to pledge allegiance to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, or what I like to call the DEI cult.

**Like me, I'm sure you receive 10+ emails a day asking you for money...**

They all say the sky is falling, but they don't provide details as to how they will use those funds.

_I'd like to break the rules._

Instead of sending you a short email, I am going to lay out a comprehensive strategy the Goldwater Institute deploys to defeat radical Marxism in our schools.

I spoke with Victor Riches, the President of Goldwater Institute, and I told him I would help them raise $50,000 in their fight against radicals in education. I am asking all my supporters to donate right away.

[Please donate $10, $35, $250, or any amount you can generously contribute >>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkks1svaapoksat8nsic0fu34pg60h64vu1u51j0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)

The radical indoctrination of our education didn’t occur overnight. It took decades to unfold. And let me shoot straight with you... conservatives won’t fix it overnight. But the Goldwater Institute is attacking on all fronts. They’ve been in this fight for more than a decade, bringing school choice and protecting parental rights across the country.
Here’s what the Goldwater Institute is doing that makes them unique among conservative organizations.

Defending Parental Rights While in her 13-year-old daughter’s room, Amber Lavigne was shocked to find a chest binder—an undergarment used to flatten breasts.

Upon further investigation, Amber discovered that her daughter had been secretly given the chest binder by a school social worker. This social worker had advised Amber’s daughter about gender transitioning and, worse yet, told her it would be best not to inform her parents.

The school violated Amber's parental rights as protected by the Constitution. In response, the Goldwater Institute is suing to hold the school accountable for its actions.

This radical ideology has no place in our schools, and it’s the latest in the battle against cultural Marxism. Goldwater is defending parental rights by providing parents with legal assistance to stop schools that violate the law.

[Can you contribute to the Goldwater Institute by donating $10, $35, or any amount today? Please help me raise $50,000 for them this week.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z1l24i7nn83mgg1p8bml9qcgi2scaab8k3nnndh8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)

[Donate $35](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zup2i3t8t6v64q633kqakdef3c6hiuut8vacqn1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)

[Donate $1,000](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zodlqq2d89a5fe3l31a4iann7h9oie8ra01u9tqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)

[Donate Any Amount](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zq81m0vtb1ca0q9l8not3t2kft6ohif1nvdsb008_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cthm8or2cth2bs)
School Choice Every parent deserves to send their children to the school that best fits their needs. Low-income families should not be stuck in failing school districts, and all parents should have the option to take their kids out of schools indoctrinating them in leftist nonsense.

The Goldwater Institute is a trailblazer in advocating for school choice and parental rights. Goldwater not only fights for school choice in the legislature, but they also protect school choice in the courts.

Through their efforts, Arizona was the first state to pass universal school choice, giving all families access to the educational options most suitable to them.

The Goldwater Institute’s exemplary school choice legislation set a precedent for the rest of the nation. Goldwater has assisted Iowa, Michigan, Utah, and West Virginia in implementing universal school choice programs, and they have no intention of stopping until school choice is a nationwide reality.

## Bannon Ordered to Begin Jail Term
A federal judge ordered Steve Bannon, a longtime ally of former President Trump, to [report to prison](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL8GOjwIMIcLiteo82tTapB0WJfBoEFnZfL3GadOvTtb7Md9uicqVB__0xMj5zalhenEyStQxk1OrjEjGrQS4wADgLfXoOUWXbY3b80y57y6OczZXK1NOrgVwuqClxSNNk57DTpc_WAvFga8weBDWBZ9wyycxpW49ctno8ob5vLdTuyXpT1liRvzfgj7T5hRmJE33KiUNxNm7Ph4lcTUqjDj0l6d1ZyYCx7CjA40WAvqYDxRzanWVtXe6WhVpX3HVN6W7HHdv6gUOjwIpx_PRL95yX9-OKP5CQAA__8MyV_Z) by July 1 to begin a four-month prison sentence for contempt of Congress. Bannon, a well-known conservative political consultant, was [convicted in 2022](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL8GOjwIMIcLiteo82tTapB0WJfBoEFnZfL3GadOvTtb7Md9uicqVB__0xMj5zalhenEyStQxk1OrjEjGrQS4wADgLfXoOUWXbY3b80y57y6OczZXK1NOrgVwuqClxSNNk57DTpc_WAvFga8weBDWBZ9wyycxpW49ctno8ob5vLdTuyXpT1liRvzfgj7T5hRmJE33KiUNxNm7Ph4lcTUqjDj0l6d1ZyYCx7CjA40WAvqYDxRzanWVtXe6WhVpX3HVN6W7HHdv6gUOjwIpx_PRL95yX9-OKP5CQAA__8MyV_Z) for defying a subpoena from the now-defunct House Jan. 6 committee and failing to appear for a deposition. A three-judge appeals court panel [upheld Bannon's conviction ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhiAUBeCnwQ2DgFwdGLq4_V07GsTLLw2CkRtN376xc7cvOTk5yfl6zS8XU8zvT7ejpVBm5yleOBsOXOpZN6sNiBJVg7aDDsCofhDNZsdV62Vw6wJBgdB9UMIBjsL3i1NSjk20UkgtjAAx9KZTrYIOR-jMMHgvRgxMC1wjlbP9LjHThiH9lAvP1pe9SXYjOipTH0xOTE73fbd-qRnv-uRMTg-ZnCrhhXxxOZfMK2bC7JEfZ6wlc18y4X4QL-Hx-8T6dJrTrscdU4rVANPivbuY_mbp3w8uK38DAAD__wWFYAI)last month. On Thursday, the federal court revoked his bail, ruling that Bannon should serve jail time while appealing his case.
## COVID Vaccines Blamed in Excess Deaths
The COVID vaccines [may be partly responsible](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9ugzAQgPGnMdshc_wxDB4aRQyVUqlTR-TaR3yVMQg70Lx91c6dv-XT7-M23QwHjvc3s5DO8zoZm_mgqQMF2ExN4fRMhFQXpCtVKdXVbS8Lr12PquqpnW1rh6arDdoWaRicNZ9YkypYo8RGdlLJvu2quqxVRYOqur63Vg40i0aS47zu5dfKMXuaw3M9aC_tuhRB-5y3JOoXgaPA8TzPcknxtwkcKcIjCRw9mZC9wHHNnnaBo10PdnAYazlSgsU8wZuDwFPYyMH8oAA7JwKOQN-WUgJHJvsEiaMl2Ex0tLCFlB_uKXA0O1wuVXx9v16LXbvt5BA4dUo08r4YDn-z-V-5Q-NPAAAA__8tunI4) for excess deaths worldwide that have continued over the past three years, according to a new study conducted by Dutch researchers. [The study analyzed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79u6yAUgPGngQ2LA5g_A8NdvOWuHS0Ch0CFTRRTW3n7qp07f8On38dtvYXa6v74Hzb0I_c1xFFPXDUzTKhV0eQzokBJ0YMBY7ScLafFOzAShMnu7u4RQSWws7DuHnPCgMHR6gUXimtuuJ01yEkaQGdAWxsjd5iJ4pjq6K_ps9d9FMzt3U98TbFvtPkyxvMg8h8RCxHLdV3TO5TefyoRy47XQcQS-1kTO0OMdceDbeHNCrYnJpa_sDE-A3DuQE9lbI2-fHpetbV6aEMUf2yhtt_b-JN-evEdAAD__2A6Ww0) data from 47 Western nations, including the U.S., and discovered that excess mortality remained high despite the vaccine and that the cause may be related to medical problems caused by the vaccines. The scientists pointed out serious "adverse events" documented in the vaccine clinical trials that affect a percentage of people who took the vaccine, saying they lead to "either death, are life-threatening, require in-patient hospitalization," or cause other significant disabilities. The study calls on governments and policy leaders to investigate the underlying causes of an "excess mortality" rate involving [3 million deaths over three years](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnwVsQHIQjA0MXtnTtaGE4AhE2VkJc9e2rVh27f9Kv_-M6X0Ntdbu9h5XcyH0OcdSDZnPCE-hZT8llIiA1kZMoEY06WzEVh2nJ1gQNKaHOISmjKJ7zgsoC5qCn6kCAFkagsGcjFVco6YLSWBujuFBmWlCqoz_4vddtFMrtqx_04LGvU3NljP3J1BsDz8Av631_La3GQqGNwpf1_uMY-Ni3Qdv4M4WBBwZeMvAkhAALPL9a43vK08Ol_bO2Vp8GmRa3NdT2Wxv_rh8OvgMAAP__TkNaLg).
## Quicksand Half-Swallows Woman in Maine
A Maine woman strolling barefoot at Popham Beach State Park looking for sand dollars suddenly slipped hip-deep into a [patch of quicksand](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLty8yAQRp9G6uRZFsSloPgbd_7blBoMi7UJukRge_L2GbtO-X2nOXM-LtMlcOH19j8s5FvephAbP2jSgxlQTapPPhMhyZ68MMIYLUcL_ewxOjRgcgQcMeQoNJDKoHQMox3p2rNHQAUaDNhRC3mSRpAzQlsbIzjKnQJK3Lbj9Lnx2mbK5Wd70HGK29IXP7e2107-6_Dc4TnsKz3rC73G0TgW6vC8BF5puFKI8_B95_hVw5qGet_pqKHdj9AoDe9PXZOAnIw0Ca1MTrrkHAFqQnDWqv7waX9yKVy16RTclsDlrdL-7PLw-BsAAP__9INjzw), a phenomenon seldom seen outside of old Hollywood action movies. Jamie Acord said she was discussing dinner plans with her husband right before [she found herself up to her waist](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFytCAYRZ8GOxwEBLeg-Bu7_duUzrd4WUkQjJI1efvMZiZdmlvdmXPmvFynK8UU8_0_rXA1lIl8jQ9Mhlsu9aSb2QVAQjVwne2sNaofRLM48kPoQ-gFTA9A003RbHTnxUUNc48mOimkFkZYMfSmU62yHS62M8PgvbggMC0wx1r29rXEXBeE9FUe2Ftf1ia5pdbtYOofkyOT43merUeuO6WVYsbzxOT4RDA5CvM77x_Rvx2UZ47PDXtE9uBHpb0mHPwsK2VOlW9lW2jlN5BfmByb3c3bGVOKh7FMi_tKMf141D-jPJz8DgAA__9cMGRt) in quicksand. "All of a sudden I was hip-deep in a wet slurry of sand," she said. "I couldn't feel the bottom and I couldn't get a footing." According to park officials, areas of quicksand occasionally show up at the beach, and recent flooding and erosion have left the sand overly saturated. [It's not uncommon ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7tyqzAQgOGnEZ2Y1R0KFaeh82lTMotYzCbiEixbk7fPJHXqv_jne7uNN-TM-_0_bhTLcoyYCr9o9DJIbUfbzHEh0mQaiiqoELxxHTRr7K33MFnXW5iQpmTt7PvJoEbjvFOu4ahBW_AQoHNemdYERX1QvutSgp4WYYFmLsfVvh-8l5WW_HW86GrTsTU5rqWcD2H-CT0IPdRa27qV-hOFHvAqnDIJPXw-OX08cJ8lFonyPM5nxktuyDvJiTCtQg9eAXTgoLnifFbOmR8-CAv3DTn__sqf-FfU3wEAAP__eRlayA)for people to sink a few feet or up to their waist in some spots. If you find yourself in quicksand, officials say to stay calm, lean forward, and climb out. In Jamie's case, she screamed until her husband picked her up.

| | | The decision to run against Senator Menendez was one of the most consequential decisions of my life. The reason I stepped up is because I’m tired of constantly watching our politics fail our nation. We are just cycling from crisis to crisis, and too many politicians aren’t focused on what the American people need help with. Right now, a staggering 84 percent of people in New Jersey believe NJ politicians are corrupt. The people of New Jersey deserve a choice for what kind of public servant they have in the Senate. Instead of throwing up my hands and giving up, I am stepping up to show that there is a better way. We deserve leaders who can serve with integrity. Leaders who are workhorses, not show horses. After Menendez’s scandal, we need a fresh new start — a chance to lift up a new generation of leadership that can bring a new voice and deep public service experience to the U.S. Senate. It’s been clear for some time that our campaign’s momentum is incredible. We went from being the underdog to becoming the Democratic Nominee. There’s a long way to go between now and November though – and Bob Menendez officially running as an Independent, making this a three-way race. We need to make sure that we sustain and keep growing our momentum to unify our party and build a broad coalition of support for keeping this seat blue in November. The only way we’ll win is through grassroots power and investments today in things like voter outreach, and that’s why I’m asking you to help us hit our $100,000 Blue Jersey goal by the end of the week. [I’m humbled to be the Democratic Nominee in New Jersey, and now I’m asking: Can you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help us keep this seat blue and stop a MAGA takeover of the Senate? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0e798483-74d5-4ebd-9aaf-166945b84966/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We need to make sure that we sustain and keep growing our momentum to unify our party and build a broad coalition of support for keeping this seat blue in November. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. subject: Are you ready for the end times?

| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MDAxMCJ9/0imnHCbiuOVS0F2LfcK3Nw)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MDAxMCJ9/UKK_WSZQN7JjEjAIWktsSA)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MDAxMCJ9/84_LOCjM1sySz3BDM820Rg)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____

| | | | | **Youngkin Approval Rating 56% In New Poll**
**ICYMI:** Governor Glenn Youngkin's approval rating remains strong in a [new poll](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=9b7513a0ddf982f65cbb45c19c8061f9cfb629d7b4d74d557993a9f90394a7c36503da3176a755296e16f484a1d28ef7cdb14da83a9acf8f057f618f0d85e0f0 "new poll"), with a 56% approval rating among Virginians. Among independents, Youngkin's approval rating is even higher at 61%.
---
| [](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=9b7513a0ddf982f657f3a0da6b9cd6f6cf8c93d7909c42018134120b87dbb29736853a5a87f74eac6a304dab22546f80f1317ed3e92eeea5bf596957c3cf3490)

---
| | | Youngkin's strong approval rating stands in stark contrast to the abysmal approval rating of President Joe Biden among Virginians.

Joe Biden is underwater in his approval rating by 14 points, with just 43% of Virginians approving of the job he is doing as president while 57% disapprove. Among independents, Biden's disapproval rating sits at 62%.

The new poll also confirms what Governor Youngkin has been saying repeatedly: Virginia is in play in the 2024 presidential election. According to the poll, Donald Trump and Joe Biden are tied in Virginia - a state Joe Biden won in 2020 by 10 points.
---

| [](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=9b7513a0ddf982f60d3f99aecfec5af2d0d66a5a6921a700c58ddfeed8f63e3148093f13da00fb8dcaa207e510f2073d19c855296ea42377edc7d31d3a8aceea)

"It reflects the fact that Americans and Virginians are ready for strong leadership back in the White House. That strength is projected not only in economic strength - it's national security strength, it's energy policy strength, it's a secure border, it's an America that we know needs to be strong. What they've seen from Joe Biden has been weakness and I think Americans and Virginians are ready to really give President Trump the White House back," **Youngkin said. **

body:
| | | | | |

[](https://voteadammorgan.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7bd623e292b79126690dd777&id=2c5fab1601&e=0c28832e87)
|
Friend,
I am writing to you as a wife, mother and concerned citizen of the Upstate of South Carolina. Some of you might know me as "princess pirate" from the many Patch the Pirate adventures my family journeyed on together over the years through Majesty Music. My father, Ron Hamilton, led our family with the truth of Scripture (and encouraged millions of other families across the world too!).
When my dad was diagnosed with dementia, I could never have imagined the man I was dating at the time, Adam Morgan, would not only continue the legacy of my father in leading our family music business and ministry, but he would also become my hero - a bold champion for our community leading for conservative values.
Adam is kind, smart, and speaks the truth no matter the cost. As his wife, I have watched as he led the fight in the South Carolina State House as a Representative. He helped to established the SC Freedom Caucus, a band of brave conservatives, and stood on the front lines to protect and defend our liberties, our children and our values.
Our country is at a crossroads where men and women must stand strong. I have seen firsthand how the pressure is potent to cave on your values - and equally, I have watched Adam be unmoved by it. As his wife, I am so proud and thankful for his humble, faithful spirit that continues in truth, even when the pressure is on!
Adam is a man of integrity. He is my best friend, a true leader, a gentle father to our children and a happy conservative warrior. I am so incredibly grateful to stand by his side as he follows God's leading in public service to our community.
I ask you to vote for my husband, Adam Morgan, for our next Congressman.
Sincerely, Megan Morgan

sponsor:

There's
something I want to ask you…

Do you
believe we're right to focus on educating students rather than
activism?

I want
your thoughts because you're essential to our efforts.

YOU'RE
THE REASON why our students finished the spring semester with
studying, finals, and commencement…

Rather
than pro-terror protests, occupying campus buildings, setting up
tent encampments, or overwhelming police with violence.

YOU'RE
THE REASON why our professors teach students about our country's
great heritage of liberty and the importance of Western
Civilization to our liberties…

Rather
than indoctrinating students with lies about America being a
murderous nation built on stolen land…let alone being
arrested for joining these violent mobs!

YOU'RE
THE REASON why we can reach and teach millions of Americans
nationwide through Imprimis and free online courses while
restoring excellence to K-12 education…

Rather
than letting far-left propaganda take over our schools and
culture with the help of big-money progressive donors and
taxpayer dollars.

When I
see what is happening on other college and university campuses, I
am so grateful for your friendship and support.

You truly
make our college a place that seeks to DEFEND LIBERTY rather than
OVERTHROW IT.

And
because you're essential to our efforts here, there's a big favor
I need to ask of you…

It's the
end of our fiscal year when we make plans for the coming academic
year-including our national educational outreach. That's where
you come in…

After you
let me know whether we're right to focus on EDUCATION and not
activism…

Can you
please let me know where you think we should focus during the
next academic year? You can tell me using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63260363:sWPTd6W4N:m:3:2532013465:54C216827EE5916238CA7AB7527EFC16:r

fiscal year ends on June 30…so I hope to hear from you
before then.

Before I
let you go, please give me just five seconds to remind you why
our work is so important and why we need YOU to help.

It's no
secret that these campus radicals get their inspiration from the
student protestors of 1968…

Our
country has changed a lot since then. And I would say-and I think
you agree-not for the better.

A big
reason is that many of these radicals took over our education
system…as professors, administrators, and government
bureaucrats.

Hillsdale
is one of the only colleges in this country that hasn't fallen
into this madness.

We are
one of the only colleges that teach young Americans-and millions
of people around this country-what makes our country the freest
and most prosperous nation in history.

And we do
so without ONE PENNY of government funding…even indirectly
in the form of student grants or loans.

That's
what YOU DO with your support.

So, thank
you so much. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm
regards,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President

Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale
College

P.S. I
have two quick questions for you today…

Do
you believe we're right to focus on educating students rather
than activism?

Where
should we focus our educational efforts in the coming school
year?

Please
let me know! It'll only take a moment of your time. And after you
weigh in, it would be such a blessing if you could help us with
our fiscal year-end fundraising campaign. Thanks in advance for
your help. You can let me know your thoughts at this secure link:

# Cost of Living

Peter - every year, and especially in reeling from the Covid-19 pandemic, things are getting harder for families to afford.

Housing costs continue to rise while wages remain stagnant.

Healthcare continues to be out of reach for many Americans.

And our representatives that are sent to Washington, D.C., are not addressing these common issues. Instead, we see divisive rhetoric and culture war talking points used as scapegoats to avoid the real problems that impact everyday Americans.

The people across this great nation and those in District 8 of Texas deserve someone that will fight for their ability to maintain a healthy, normal life.

[**Peter, if you are ready to see that representation in our state is changed, then please chip in today. While I'm grateful my home state of Illinois has abolished the death penalty, as of June 2024, another 27 states still permit the practice. Those states are Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Wyoming.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/81aecf49-de11-413c-8229-2d9e9ab8c2f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So, especially if you live in one of these states, I encourage you to read and share this insight to help abolish the death penalty in your state.
Why?
It's quite simple, really. If we truly care about equal justice under the Constitution, we must abolish the death penalty nationwide. Below, I address the criticisms of abolishment, and debunk five of the most common myths cited in support.
**So, Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145400427&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NDAwNDI3LCJpYXQiOjE3MTc3NjUyOTAsImV4cCI6MTcyMDM1NzI5MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.hV9iQ6MQszJvLi0wTmaZjcQJ8otf4Ra4QSNAie7nV24)
### Claim: We know for certain that innocent people are not convicted or put to death, and if they are, it is a tiny and insignificant number.
Unfortunately, we know the opposite is true. [Since 1973 alone](https://substack.com/redirect/8210c740-2e47-460c-9a75-d452b79a1472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> ...at least 197 people who had been wrongly convicted and sentenced to death in the U.S. have been exonerated.
In the modern era, America has executed roughly 1500 people for capital crimes.
With 197 known exonerations--solely because additional investigations were performed--that suggests the horrifying fact that at least 1 out of every 9 people executed were actually innocent. That is an 11% error rate. We wouldn't tolerate that error rate in any other scenario. Imagine if on your next flight the pilot got on the intercom and announced there's an 11% chance the plane won't work once it's in flight. Or an 11% chance a physician misdiagnoses cancer? Why then, would we tolerate an 11% error rate for the death penalty, when even 1 wrongful execution is 1 too many. This is simply unconscionable and is the antithesis of justice. We must do better, and that begins by abolishing the death penalty nationwide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/650bfd55-9ead-4844-bea1-fd6775e7572f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Daniel Gwynn, who was convicted of first-degree murder in 1994, was finally exonerated after 30 years in 2024. [Credit: 6abc Philadelphia]
### Claim: The death penalty is a deterrent to violent crime.
On the contrary, [study after study shows no link](https://substack.com/redirect/a65d27c6-2923-4293-8b81-ffc7f98022e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between the presence or abolishment of the death penalty and the rate of violent crime historically punished with the death penalty.
The Death Penalty Information Center, which collects studies on this topic, [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/a65d27c6-2923-4293-8b81-ffc7f98022e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The death penalty affects only a tiny percentage of even those who commit murder. Its effect is very difficult to pinpoint, and the National Academy of Sciences has concluded that past studies have neither proven nor disproven a deterrent effect.
In short, the claim that the practice deters violent crime is just that--a claim. No actual evidence exists to support this assumption.
### Claim: The victims of violent crime won't see justice if the death penalty is repealed.
Let's be clear. For the victims and families of violent crime, especially involving murder, nothing can bring back a life lost. No words or actions exist to remedy their pain. That's why it's so much more important we recognize that execution and justice are two different things altogether, and we cannot make the mistake of conflating them.
Enacting the death penalty won't bring back a life lost to a horrific crime. Once that crime is committed, however, society can ensure the culprit is prevented from committing further harm. Families of victims can and should pursue restitution, damages, and financial compensation for the loss of their loved one--and receive them quickly.
Meanwhile, cases often take years or even decades. That leaves the lives of the victim's families and the culprit's families in limbo. Instead, the culprit should face swift accountability with prison. That allows victim families to move on without having to relive trauma with ongoing court cases. But speaking of justice, as I iterate below, given how many innocent people are sentenced to death, justice mandates abolishment to prevent the wrongful conviction and execution of the innocent.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..kBUPmyyP3mhnD-JE1axHEyknImoOkffnKy2fEXFh4l4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145400427)
### Claim: It is a waste of taxpayer dollars to house, cloth, and feed a violent criminal until they die in prison.
In reality, [death penalty cases cost about 48% more](https://substack.com/redirect/b3899761-5f3b-45f3-b4dd-ea01324e4282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than the cost of sentencing someone to life in prison. [Likewise](https://substack.com/redirect/b3899761-5f3b-45f3-b4dd-ea01324e4282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> A New Jersey study found, between 1983 and 2005, taxpayers paid $253 million _more_ for the death penalty system than for a system with life without parole as its maximum sentence.
In short, if cost truly is the concern, then life in prison is far more efficient a use of taxpayer funds than is the death penalty.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..kBUPmyyP3mhnD-JE1axHEyknImoOkffnKy2fEXFh4l4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145400427)
### Claim: The death penalty is the great equalizer, applied fairly across economic and racial class.
On the contrary, the death penalty is one of the most grotesque examples of racially and economically discriminatory application of the law. For example, of the 173 exonerated former death row inmates, 91 are Black. Put another way, Black Americans are only 13% of the population, but were 53% of those wrongly convicted of a capital offense. Moreover, of those on death row, [42% are Black](https://substack.com/redirect/050c8f4b-e3dc-45d1-b3bd-aa80a4b61979?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), once again demonstrating the racial bias in our legal system. In states like California, for example, the death penalty has not been abolished but is now in a moratorium, in part by evidence that Black defendants are 8.7X more likely to be sentenced to death than are white defendants for the exact same crimes. This racial disparity in California is not the exception nationwide, but the norm--and that's truly frightening.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0fbc6a7d-c232-45e7-92d8-09fe2e2f3620?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Likewise, while the wealthy can afford world class legal representation and avoid the penalty, this is a punishment disproportionately reserved for the poor and destitute. Such an unjust system cannot be allowed to continue.
**In conclusion:**
It is no wonder that Americans are committed to ending this practice. Polling shows that more than [60% of Americans support life in prison over the death penalty](https://substack.com/redirect/df4e61af-e5ad-43d7-8a02-f272990750ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It is a shame, therefore, that despite overwhelming support from the American people, and despite the ample evidence demonstrating the death penalty is unjust and does not make our nation safer, 27 states still permit capital punishment. We must embrace the movement to end the death penalty in America, nationwide, and better fulfill our Constitutional promise of equal justice under the law.
It's long past due we embrace this opportunity for justice.

body:
Join us for an important discussion on education choice!
| | | |
---
| | Derek,
You're Invited: **[Education Freedom Forum](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)** - Empowering Families with Choice!

As part of my campaign for Governor, I am committed to ensuring that every child has the opportunity to succeed by expanding universal education choice.
As Senate President, I was proud to lead the passage of Education Freedom Accounts, bringing greater flexibility and opportunities to families across our state. Now, I am advocating for a universal approach, believing that every family should have the ability to choose the best educational path for their children. Join us at the forum to:
* Learn about the benefits of education choice and how it empowers families in New Hampshire.
* Discuss the successes of our current initiatives and explore the potential of universal implementation.
* Hear from experts, parents, and educators about the transformative impact of educational freedom.

Your voice and perspective are crucial as we shape the future of our educational landscape. Let's come together to fight for our children's futures with facts! The Forumn will include special guest speakers including Senator Ruth Ward and Director of the Children's Scholarship Fund of New Hampshire, Kate Baker.
I look forward to seeing you at the forum and working together to make New Hampshire a leader in educational choice.
In Liberty, Chuck Morse

Ruben Gallego is much, much more dangerous than you could ever imagine. He would be worse than bad for this nation; he would be CATASTROPHIC. It's not enough to tell you that Ruben has voted with Joe Biden 100% of the time. He's not just a bad legislator. He's a horrible person and a total tool to the swamp. When we say Ruben is in bed with the same people who tried to bribe me and force me to stay away from politics, we mean it literally. He divorced his NINE-MONTH PREGNANT WIFE to be with a superstar DC Lobbyist. He even ripped off taxpayers to pay for his Washington D.C. townhouse and did shady dealings with a bank that allegedly defrauded immigrant families and Latinos (the very people he claims to fight for.) The only thing Ruben will do in the Senate is pay back the favors he owes his financial backers.If he had any interest in helping the people of Arizona, his district wouldn't have the fastest-growing homeless population in the entire country. You probably know by now how bad Ruben Gallego would be for Arizona and the entire country. The problem is, as of right now, he's more than two points ahead of me in the polls, he has a campaign war chest FILLED to the brim with dirty money, and almost FORTY MILLION DOLLARS pledged towards TV ads before the election. I'm fighting SO HARD to stay competitive with Ruben Gallego because I won't let my kids, Ruby and Leo, live in the left's planned Socialist Paradise. I don't owe favors to corporate entities or make promises to leftist elites. I have only ever asked for help from patriotic, grassroots Americans like yourself, and ONLY if you can spare it. I'm hoping I can count on you to donate $5, $10, $25, or maybe even $50 to help my Senate campaign. IF you can't spare even $5, all I'm asking for is one dollar. IF you've never donated before, or you're skeptical your donation will make a difference, I want you to trust me when I tell you every single cent counts. It's only TOGETHER that we can Save Arizona and TAKE BACK AMERICA! Please donate ANYTHING you can spare below! | Thank you, Kari Lake Candidate for U.S. Senate in Arizona Paid for by Kari Lake for Senate If you'd like to donate by mail, **.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Will you join me in calling on the Supreme Court to disarm domestic violence?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
People subject to domestic violence restraining orders shouldn’t be allowed to own guns. Period.
#

_We’d like to let you know that the email below discusses domestic violence. If this is not something you’d like to read about today, please click away._
_If you or someone you love is in danger, please know that you are not alone. There are resources available to you. Call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text “START” to 88788 to be connected with an advocate._
* * *
Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to reach out to you personally about the Supreme Court case _United States v. Rahimi_ , which the court is expected to make a decision on any day now.
This case was taken up by the Supreme Court in 2023 after the Fifth Circuit struck down the decades-old federal law that prohibits people subject to domestic violence restraining orders from possessing guns.
**The gun lobby and other extremists are hoping that a Supreme Court ruling in _Rahimi_ , using the 2022 _Bruen_ decision—which requires courts to focus on the historical interpretation of the Second Amendment—will restore the gun rights of people convicted of domestic abuse.**
[**Will you join me in calling on the Supreme Court to reinstate the ban on people convicted of domestic abuse owning guns by signing GIFFORDS’ petition?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_june24/?source=em240607-1-30&refcode2=8262.3935704.eez087&akid=8262%2E3935704%2Eeez087)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_june24/?source=em240607-1-30&refcode2=8262.3935704.eez087&akid=8262%2E3935704%2Eeez087)**
With this case, countless lives are in the hands of our judicial system—particularly the lives of women—who are disproportionately impacted by domestic violence. Every year, more than 600 American women are shot and killed by intimate partners. And millions more have been threatened with a gun.
I have firsthand experience, like far too many women in this country, with the devastation and trauma that can be wrought by a hateful, angry man who has access to a gun. Although my case was not related to domestic violence, I was shot by an angry man thirteen years ago.
With _Rahimi_ , the Supreme Court has a critical opportunity to demonstrate that we care about protecting women’s lives.
**People subject to domestic violence restraining orders shouldn’t be allowed to own guns. Period.**
[**So please, will you join me in calling on the Supreme Court to make the right choice in the _Rahimi_ case and ensure we protect women from domestic violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_june24/?source=em240607-1-30&refcode2=8262.3935704.eez087&akid=8262%2E3935704%2Eeez087)
Thank you for using your voice. This is so important.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=8262%2E3935704%2Eeez087) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

In national security, there is what’s called the five-paragraph order way of presenting information, or SMEAC. It’s a way of strategizing that lays out all of the pertinent information and presents a problem and solution. We thought, given Elissa’s penchant for bringing strategic planning into her role as an elected official, we could apply that same format to our race at hand:
**Situation:** We are 8 weeks away from finding out who our Republican opponent will be, spending against us has ramped up, and our first ads of the campaign are on the air.
**Mission:** Hit our fundraising goals before our FEC fundraising deadline ends – this is our most important fundraising goal yet, and will shape the strength of our campaign as we enter the final months of this race.
**Execution:** This deadline is the first time the majority of our fundraising has to come from lots and lots of people making small-dollar donations when they can afford it.
**Administration / Logistics:** We will use the resources raised to communicate with the undecided voters across the state who will determine who wins this race. We'll do it via organizing voter contact and communication as well as paid communication like television and digital ads.
**Command:** As the candidate, Elissa will be traveling the state and talking to voters, but as someone who knows what it takes to win tough races, she and our team will be making final decisions on budget allocation as well. | | | | | Peter, I have served this country my entire life. Now that I’ve retired from the US Army as a Brigadier General, I’m ready to continue my service in a new arena. I live in the Georgia district currently represented by Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think my neighbors deserve better. Over the course of 40 years in the armed forces, I served our country in various capacities, including as an infantry commander in Afghanistan following the tragic events of 9/11. I ultimately worked as a senior military advisor at military posts around the world. That means I was providing strategic guidance and leadership to keep our nation strong against foreign adversaries. I took an oath to protect the US Constitution from all enemies, foreign AND domestic. When I left the Army to start my farm here in North Georgia, I discovered that my country still needed me. The current US Congress is the weakest, most chaotic legislature in my memory, and my district is right at the heart of it. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T87597e4c-165b-4785-80f3-01d2761a08c0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I think Georgia deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think America deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. My background on both the enlisted and officer side of the armed forces has prepared me to address the complex challenges facing our nation today. That starts with core American values we are severely lacking from some of our elected officials today.

subject: Can I tell you a story, friend?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF SHERROD BROWN
body:
I loved growing up in Ohio
| | |
---
Can I tell you a story, friend?

I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio – a working-class town between Cleveland and Columbus. My dad was a doctor and my mom was a local activist, leading the Ohio Hunger Task Force and our YWCA. They taught me what it meant to be a part of a community – to care for your neighbors as you care about your friends and family.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86450313/477918039/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1968-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGRmNzdlYy1kNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3nX9CRhQ8oUISklalNXW1eQ1J0ScI6QMzkdIfdxfqM=)
My parents couldn't have been prouder when I became an Eagle Scout as a teenager, and their influence is one of the biggest reasons I got into public service.

I loved growing up in Ohio, especially attending Cleveland baseball games with my dad. I'm proud to call Ohio home to this day – my wife, Connie, and I now live in Cleveland with our rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86450314/477918040/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1968-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGRmNzdlYy1kNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3nX9CRhQ8oUISklalNXW1eQ1J0ScI6QMzkdIfdxfqM=)
When I was a kid, Mansfield was made up of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. Back then, those were jobs you could count on to own a home, support a family, and save up for a comfortable retirement. Over the years, we've seen jobs shipped overseas and the cost of living rise dramatically while wages remain stagnant, all in service of big corporations and the rich and powerful – and at the expense of working families.
I got involved in public service because I believe our country is better than that, and I wanted to make sure it lives up to its promises. Today in the Senate, I'm fighting for progress on the issues that matter most to workers and families, from better wages and safer working conditions to protecting affordable health care **and** the Social Security benefits folks have worked for their whole lives.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86450315/477918041/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1968-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGRmNzdlYy1kNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e3nX9CRhQ8oUISklalNXW1eQ1J0ScI6QMzkdIfdxfqM=)
**But the truth is, I need your help to keep up this fight, friend. I'm facing my toughest race yet, with _CNN_ analysts calling me one of the most vulnerable senators in the country and _Politico_ analysts reporting this race could decide Senate control. Now, Mitch McConnell has personally listed me as a top GOP target. I know we can win this thing, but it's going to take a historic outpouring of grassroots support, and I need you on my team.**

clean_body: I loved growing up in Ohio | | | Can I tell you a story, friend? I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio – a working-class town between Cleveland and Columbus. My dad was a doctor and my mom was a local activist, leading the Ohio Hunger Task Force and our YWCA. They taught me what it meant to be a part of a community – to care for your neighbors as you care about your friends and family. = My parents couldn't have been prouder when I became an Eagle Scout as a teenager, and their influence is one of the biggest reasons I got into public service. I loved growing up in Ohio, especially attending Cleveland baseball games with my dad. I'm proud to call Ohio home to this day – my wife, Connie, and I now live in Cleveland with our rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter. = When I was a kid, Mansfield was made up of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. Back then, those were jobs you could count on to own a home, support a family, and save up for a comfortable retirement. Over the years, we've seen jobs shipped overseas and the cost of living rise dramatically while wages remain stagnant, all in service of big corporations and the rich and powerful – and at the expense of working families. I got involved in public service because I believe our country is better than that, and I wanted to make sure it lives up to its promises. Today in the Senate, I'm fighting for progress on the issues that matter most to workers and families, from better wages and safer working conditions to protecting affordable health care and the Social Security benefits folks have worked for their whole lives. = But the truth is, I need your help to keep up this fight, friend. I'm facing my toughest race yet, with CNN analysts calling me one of the most vulnerable senators in the country and Politico analysts reporting this race could decide Senate control. Now, Mitch McConnell has personally listed me as a top GOP target. I know we can win this thing, but it's going to take a historic outpouring of grassroots support, and I need you on my team. = Every dollar truly makes a difference – thanks in advance for giving what you can. = | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Like most Granite Staters, I look forward to the start of summer. My family and I hike nearby trails and walk in the woods, but there is always one thing in the back of our minds: Lyme disease.

Because of our warm winter, we’re seeing ticks earlier than ever. That means more infections. It also means more frantic visits to the doctor for the telltale bulls eye rash or anxiety around pulling a tick of a child.

Granite Staters know Lyme is hard to diagnose and even harder to treat - and for some, it can be hard to get insurance to cover their treatment. We need to stand up for the millions grappling with this disease.

**[As a member of Congress, one of my goals will be to help fund more Lyme disease research. But I can't do this alone.
