name: David Costello for U.S. Senate Update
subject: Campaign Update
body:
| | | | |
---
|
# Campaign Update
---
| Dear Friend,
Just a brief update, last Friday and Saturday, David attended the Maine State Democratic Convention in Bangor, the city of his birth and “big” city of his childhood and teen years. At the convention, David had the opportunity to meet and speak with fellow Maine democrats on many of today’s most pressing issues. David delivered remarks at the convention; these highlighted his reasons for running for the U.S. senate and his desire “to help in advancing long-overdue legislative and constitutional reforms that will not only aid in strengthening our democracy and government, but also help in better protecting our rights and freedoms – including women’s reproductive rights and LGBTQ freedoms – and more effectively assist in addressing such critical issues as climate change, escalating gun violence, economic inequality, unaffordable housing and health care, and insufficient retirement security”.
Also in his speech, David outlined the specific reforms that he supports, including: banning gerrymandering and eliminating Senate “holds” and filibusters; requiring social media companies to adhere to reasonable public interest rules: ratifying the “For Our Freedom Amendment” to better regulate campaign contributions and spending; abolishing the Electoral College; imposing sensible term limits and retirement age requirements on legislators and judges – including Supreme Court justices; and restructuring the U.S. House and Senate so that their allocation of power and policy decisions are more in-line with the American people’s interests, and not primarily the interests of the powerful few. Moreover, David emphasized the need to elect senators and representatives whose policy ambitions are greater than their own personal political aspirations, and who are more apt to listen to doctors, scientists, and economists, than they are to consultants, lobbyists, and wealthy donors.
Before encouraging attendees to join him in working to fix what’s broken in Washington, David acknowledged his “underdog status,” insisting that “having grown up in a working-class family in Maine and having served for more than 25 years in senior level government positions – managing complex, multi-million-dollar programs and operations, including initiatives to combat climate change, revitalize communities, protect public health and the environment, and advance peaceful democratic change in such conflict-torn countries as Cambodia, Haiti, Bosnia, and Kosovo” he believed that he has “the broadest and most fitting experience of all the candidates competing to represent Maine in the United States Senate and the soundest ideas for tackling our nation’s most pressing problems.”
Related Press NoteEmma David, Maine Monitor: “However, Trump was not the only target of critique. U.S. Senate candidate David Costello used part of his speech to voice his belief that not only Republicans but also independents have stymied Democratic progress. ‘I believe that independent candidates ... have on ballots (David actually said on balance, not on ballots) undermined and continue to undermine our party’s efforts to grow and to succeed and should therefore not be supported, at least not the first choice on our party’s rank choice ballot in November,’ Costello said.Costello, who is running against incumbent Angus King, an independent, also directly criticized his opponent as being too cautious. ‘While I appreciate that Senator King caucuses with Democrats and that he’s a safe bet,’ Costello said, ‘he’s been too reticent to pursue the kind of reforms needed to truly fix Washington’.”
David will become the official Democratic Party nominee for the United States Senate in 2024 following Tuesday’s (6/11/24) primary election. He is running unopposed.
As always, check out our website, which you can find linked down below, for more information about the campaign. And, please consider following our Instagram, Facebook and X accounts in order to stay up-to-date with campaign proceedings.
Additionally, do not hesitate to let us know of any questions or concerns and, if you are able, please consider a campaign donation. Any contribution, no matter the amount, will help in ensuring that our message of reform, REAL change, and progress is heard.
Thank you and best regards,Grace and Jack

Derek,

For far too long, Live Nation and Ticketmaster have got away with bullying artists, ripping off venues, and price-gouging customers.

After years of buying up smaller companies, only Live Nation and Ticketmaster were left. In 2009, they decided to merge, creating a monopoly over the live events industry.

The Department of Justice saw the problem, but instead of blocking the merger outright, it put guardrails in place with a consent decree that prohibited the company from forcing venues to use its ticketing services. After the deal was finalized, Ticketmaster jumped those guardrails, expanding both its power and its profits.

But now, the Department of Justice and a group of state Attorneys General have finally filed a much-anticipated antitrust suit against Live Nation and Ticketmaster.

_Derek, it’s time that we break up the Live Nation and Ticketmaster monopoly that’s ripping everybody off._

name: Andrew Horne
subject: Join Us for Crucial Volunteer Events!
body:
My Friends,
We are only 3 weeks away from ballots going out on July 3rd, and I need your help now more than ever.
Our goal is to connect with as many voters as possible and let them know who I am and why I am running. We need to express our core issues: **Women 's Rights, Gun Safety, and Public Education**. It's all about making personal connections. We’re speaking to Democratic primary voters, so our conversations are all friendly and engaging!
Here are the best opportunities for you to jump in as soon as this weekend:
[Phone Banking](https://www.mobilize.us/andrewhorneforarizona/event/615720/)

To beat the heat this weekend, we're adding more opportunities for indoor activities like phone banking and writing postcards.
This is one of the easiest ways to reach voters and spread the word about our mission to flip CD-1 Blue! Whether you can hop in for a short time once or multiple times, every little bit helps get out the vote. You can help from **anywhere in the country**. Just hop onto the website and follow the prompts—it's easy!
We are phone banking this weekend—Saturday and Sunday—and on various days until the polls close on July 30th. Please help spread the word and join us in this vital effort. [Sign up here!](https://www.mobilize.us/andrewhorneforarizona/event/615720/)
[Door Knocking](https://www.mobilize.us/andrewhorneforarizona/event/609834/)

Grab a clipboard and join us for one of our weekly community canvasses. Each canvass begins with a brief training so whether you are a first time volunteer or a veteran door knocker, this event is for you!
We will provide campaign material and water. Just make sure to dress for the weather and bring a comfortable pair of shoes. [Sign up here!](https://www.mobilize.us/andrewhorneforarizona/event/609834/)

**Postcards**

If you want to write postcards, we can drop those off with a list of addresses or send them to your friends!
Reply back to me or contact: Roemello Chavez - Horne Field Organizer Roemello@HorneForArizona.com
Thank you,

Andrew Horne
480-256-9332[](http://voice.google.com/calls?a=nc,%2B14802569332 "Call +1 480-256-9332 via Google Voice")
[www.HorneForArizona.com](http://www.HorneForArizona.com)

P.S. Your support can make a huge difference and we can’t do it without you! Let's make this campaign a success together.

body:
A country in North America actually pulled it off... now it’s our turn.| | |
---
| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86456497/477936437/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_240607macho_N_CD_90DO_13_G_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIzYjEyM2EwLWRlMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ke6KUygyaJsUtO0ZAVmuvAEKvwM9pbC1hJROXcT5JVY=)
---
Hi Peter,

Earlier this week, Mexico elected its first female president, Claudia Sheinbaum. This makes Sheinbaum the first female president in all of North America.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86456499/477936439/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_240607macho_N_CD_90DO_13_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIzYjEyM2EwLWRlMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ke6KUygyaJsUtO0ZAVmuvAEKvwM9pbC1hJROXcT5JVY=)
---
It turns out, this moment was made possible by an extremely concerted effort to increase women’s participation in Mexico’s young democracy – including the passage of a **_gender parity law._** At Her Bold Move, we are taking this news seriously – and learning all we can about Mexico’s approach to gender parity in government.

According to a recent article by the _Washington Post_ , women in Mexico didn’t gain the right to vote for president until 1953 – about 70 years ago. Not to mention, as recently as 9 years ago, the country didn’t have even one female governor.

**Now, Mexico, a country “famous for its macho culture,” has surpassed the United States in gender parity.** In addition to electing Claudia Sheinbaum as president, women hold half the seats in Mexico’s legislature (almost **_DOUBLE_** the percent of the U.S. Congress), and women lead Mexico’s Supreme Court and central bank.

| | Hi Friend,
---
Today is Wear Orange Day and this month is National Gun Violence Awareness Month.
---
However, the only reason we have these designations is because we keep experiencing gun tragedies. But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
Before my election to Congress, I was often the first person from the White House to speak with a local elected leader after a mass shooting. I have seen communities grieve and helped communities heal.
---
The scourge of gun violence across our nation is because there are too many weapons in our communities that don’t belong there. And I’m working to stop gun violence in our country at every turn by supporting an assault weapons ban, requiring a background check for every firearm sale, and prohibiting high-capacity magazines.
---
I am also proud to co-lead the Destroy Zombie Guns Act with Congressman Maxwell Frost (D-FL) to require the total destruction of a gun forfeited to a police department through gun buyback programs. This bill would prevent so-called gun disposal companies from only destroying part of a gun and reselling the remaining components after a gun buyback — which would only lead to that gun reappearing and inflicting harm in our cities and towns.
---
I hope you will join me during this Gun Violence Prevention Month to do everything possible to make sure gun violence no longer is the leading cause of death for young people in our country.
---
We must do better. We must do more.
---

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Another gut punch from the Texas Supreme Court
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
One week ago this morning, the Texas Supreme Court rejected a challenge to Texas’ abortion ban brought by women who were denied medically necessary abortions and their doctors. And it was unanimous.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240607?refcode=lpfe240607 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240607?refcode=lpfe240607]
Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , we’ve seen so many extreme abortion bans and restrictions implemented across the country, but Texas has the distinction of having some of the most draconian laws.
The rollback of rights and access in Texas didn’t start with S.B. 8, but it certainly set in motion the chaos and confusion that our state Supreme Court has now endorsed. That was in many ways the point. This latest ruling ensures the confusion will continue, offering no reassurances to doctors who could face penalties—including jail time—for performing abortions for patients with life-threatening pregnancy complications.
It’s another reminder that we cannot count on the courts—not the Texas Supreme Court or the U.S. Supreme Court—to defend our health, dignity, and freedom. We must elect leaders at every level of government who care about the health of women in Texas and across the country and who will do everything they can to protect access to reproductive care.
It’s also good to remember that in Texas we elect our judges. And three of the Texas Supreme Court justices who signed this decision are on the ballot this November.
We’ll need a sustained, systemic, strategic organization to take back our state from anti-choice extremists who don’t represent the majority of Texans. That’s why we must continue our work together, and I’m so grateful to know I can count on you to do this with us.
Together, we can do anything,

New study says Connect the Grid Act would prevent blackouts
I’ve got some important news to share, Peter.
**This week researchers at MIT’s Climate Policy Center concluded that my bill, the Connect the Grid Act, could have prevented almost all of the blackouts during Winter Storm Uri.**
Let me backup and explain.
For too long, politicians like Greg Abbott have done the bidding of billionaire donors and kept our state’s power grid isolated from the nation’s supply. They left our grid broken.
That’s why earlier this year I introduced the Connect the Grid Act, which would connect Texas to the nation’s major electric grids. Our bill would reduce carbon emissions nationwide, save consumers money, and keep the power on for millions of Texans when we need it most.
**And this week researchers at MIT exposed the truth. The blackouts that froze Texans— and killed hundreds of people— were completely preventable.**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After the International Criminal Court (ICC) investigated war crimes in
Gaza, the Court sought arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin
Netanyahu and Minister of Defense Yoav Gallant.

Now, the ICC is being punished by House Republicans and Democrats bought
out by AIPAC.

This week, 42 Democratic members of Congress joined the GOP in support of
sanctioning the ICC for its attempt to hold Israeli officials accountable

[If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott next fall, you can chip in here to help me reach my goal and flip Florida blue!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86461243/477948871/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTRmYTNmODMtZTMyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=sOGe3aN-yV7txB1hNt3EfwaJnEn1rP_yy1NWDgurhvs=) But before I dig in with the team, I want to share why doughnuts are such a big deal to me **— and how they'll help us save our Senate majority.**
| | [DOUGH-NATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86461244/477948872/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTRmYTNmODMtZTMyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=sOGe3aN-yV7txB1hNt3EfwaJnEn1rP_yy1NWDgurhvs=)

When I was 14, my family came to America with big dreams for a better life. But those early days were hard. My mom worked double shifts, yet we _still_ struggled to cover rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, once I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** Taking as many hours as I could at minimum wage wasn't easy, but the checks I brought home gave my family a little room to breathe.
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my GOP opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.
While I spent my mornings mixing, kneading, and baking before school to keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott profited off the hard work of people like me.
**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his corporate career.**
I went on to graduate from college, where I found my calling in the fight to make life a little bit easier for working-class families like mine, and later became the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress.
He went on to defraud Medicare, amass a fortune of millions, buy a Senate seat, and cozy up to Donald Trump — **and if he buys another term this fall, he could shape the Senate GOP in his extremist image as its next leader.**
So if you ask me, our differing stories in the doughnut business make the differences between us pretty clear.
**But I've seen countless times that even the smallest acts, like working at a doughnut shop for minimum wage, can make transformative change.**_**And it's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November.**_

body:
I want to share a short story about Bryce Berry, one of our Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidates.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240607&t=1&akid=781%2E587540%2EqO5OlV)
Peter,
I want to share a short story about **Bryce Berry** , one of our Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidates who’s running for the state legislature in Atlanta. It is a prime example of why the work we’re doing together is so important.
Bryce is a 7th grade teacher for the Atlanta Public School District. He started thinking about running for office when he found out that one of his students saw his father _shot and killed in front of him_ the night before.
When Bryce checked in with him, the student said “it’s okay, this kind of thing happens every day” — **because that’s just how common gun violence is in his community.**
After that, Bryce knew he couldn't just continue teaching. He felt like he had to do more for his students who not only live in danger from gun violence in their school, but also their homes.
That’s why he ran for the state legislature at just 22 years old. **And Peter, I’m happy to tell you he just won his primary election, too.**
Because he’s in a pretty blue district, that primary win makes it a pretty safe bet that Bryce is going to become the first active public school teacher and the youngest state legislator _ever elected_ in Georgia.
We can’t take anything for granted, though. This race still matters, because even though the district is typically safe territory for Democrats, the seat is currently held by a former Democrat who flipped to become a Republican in office.
Another reason this race is so important: Big turnout in Bryce’s district could prove essential to President Biden winning Georgia and securing reelection this November.
**Bryce isn’t the only candidate we’re helping out either.** Last November we helped Nadarius Clark become the youngest state delegate in Virginia. And just recently, we helped Molly Cook win a special election to fill the remainder of the current term in the Texas Senate _AND_ the Democratic primary runoff last month.
Molly will still have to win her election this November to serve a full term, and she’s not alone. There are 13 candidates who we’ve endorsed for this year’s elections so far, and they’re running all over the country.
I’m really excited to watch all of these incredible young people win big on Election Day. And Peter, please know that none of the work we do is possible without your support.
**I want to thank you, sincerely, for making this dream of mine a reality. Together, we’re going to elect badass young leaders who will change our country for the better.**
Thanks again,
David Hogg

subject: “Ted Cruz refuses to commit to accept 2024 election results”

body:
Ted Cruz cheered on the mob on January 6, led the objection to the election results certification, and then hid in a supply closet.
#
Did you see Ted Cruz's interview?
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em240607-1-tt&t=1&akid=5323%2E196590%2ENMjUNm)
We all saw with our own eyes what happened after the 2020 election: Ted Cruz cheered on the mob on January 6, led the objection to the election results certification, and then hid in a supply closet.
**And spoiler alert:** He's ready to do it again.
**We can’t let him. This November is our chance to finally hold him accountable by kicking him out of the Senate for good.**
**Polls currently show him and Colin Allred TIED in Texas, but this is shaping up to be the most expensive race in the country.[So please, will you split a contribution between Colin’s campaign and The Long Run to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz and bring real, pro-democracy leadership to Texas?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em240607-1-tt&t=2&akid=5323%2E196590%2ENMjUNm)
[DONATE](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em240607-1-tt&t=3&akid=5323%2E196590%2ENMjUNm)
Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. From leading the charge on the 2012 government shutdown to ushering in an era of extreme hyper-partisanship and pitting Americans against each other with dangerous, extremist rhetoric. **_Ted isn't just Texans' problem – he's ALL AMERICANS’ problem.**_
Ted Cruz's refusal to commit to accepting election results is exactly the kind of rhetoric that led to January 6, and another six years of him in the Senate is a danger our democracy simply can’t afford.
As a former voting rights lawyer, Colin knows firsthand how critical it is that we all remain committed to protecting our democracy and ensuring that something like January 6 never happens again. Texans deserve a leader who respects our democracy – and Colin will unequivocally accept the results of this election.
[**If you agree that Ted Cruz's extreme, anti-democracy rhetoric needs to go, please chip in now to Colin and The Long Run to help us defeat him.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em240607-1-tt&t=4&akid=5323%2E196590%2ENMjUNm)

subject: It was an honor
body:
| | | [](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=2a462b80c13b49f9874cfcacbc4b8e6a&_e=T2WL7grN88KqtiYctQeKs5j_97qFQgaFVJIITtznhbtXKx-7aHOKes_cWHyc3_hljKR6nYmJFnPdLe0E5rcRup89WvuxX13--J4xvaeQvNxHKuEAps6AqbgTRW__RlmOUwv1DriuMJVWy1iQZKaIzA4QiAZBOEsAYSOjHVlI3xaEILau6AAgqXFEN-PlynlsWoijKaOB-NtQToPYm0Bju8BESEFpPb4yjwsev6cgAVKYKWepGbLDBEcWjPDcwojiOY10kSYBQo2wylqBlu22U9vrVl2epTapuHgX7vgAXz3zz_AAKqoKn09xZvNLlsih_e_6ePfPcKqwAOyAGGo-_0pJkFzcgto-CbRWzTcsOiLHKh2I6JXs9r2qbX8lsbYbSNkvOVrdqcq63WqCnQ22Mw%3D%3D)
---
Joined by my fellow veteran colleagues, I parachuted into Normandy on the 80th anniversary of the D-Day invasion. _**It was an honor.**_ I was filled with emotion as I looked out from my parachute at the battlefield where so many American soldiers sacrificed their lives in defense of this country. _**Eighty years may have passed, but patriotic Americans will NEVER forget the sacrifices that so many young men made so that we could live free!**_ Veterans should be treated with the utmost respect. But as you know, radical Leftists in our country despise veterans’ service or leadership. For instances, whether you believe it or not, I’m the first Green Beret ever elected to Congress! It’s a unit that’s existed longer than I’ve been alive – it’s shocking it took so long. There are too many examples of ungrateful liberals undermining and even attacking veterans. One of the worst instances I’ve seen is how they’ve treated my friend and colleague, Derrick Van Orden.
---
[](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=2a462b80c13b49f9874cfcacbc4b8e6a&_e=T2WL7grN88KqtiYctQeKs5j_97qFQgaFVJIITtznhbtXKx-7aHOKes_cWHyc3_hljKR6nYmJFnPdLe0E5rcRup89WvuxX13--J4xvaeQvNxHKuEAps6AqbgTRW__RlmOUwv1DriuMJVWy1iQZKaIzA4QiAZBOEsAYSOjHVlI3xaEILau6AAgqXFEN-PlynlsWoijKaOB-NtQToPYm0Bju8BESEFpPb4yjwsev6cgAVLv3o108MyhV7sDMoqS44YDLmuxvPC8cgggW_8iyNDqwmOTWJNiaHCMnqz7hi-Zw-AArPzoY6D3053uiC3p1cOn2qfTkcvFEMw1Y6I5Hz6Z2I1EITSNkR3plo5RulYKESn_QGfRLsWDIG5jUIKPpzwel1K-oFNCKMvOH-VjWjy0Yw%3D%3D)
---
Derrick Van Orden here. I also made the jump with Mike - It was an honor and a privilege to be a part of such an incredible tribute to our nation’s heroes. I’d like to tell you a bit about myself if you have a moment. I’m a Retired Navy SEAL Senior Chief who gave 26 years of service to this country. I’m just a regular guy who loves his country. I’m still serving this nation in Congress alongside my friend, Mike Waltz. Despite my service and patriotism, the radical Left is laser-focused on making sure I’m GONE in November. They can’t stand to see a fearless veteran call out their extremist agenda! If you support veterans and want to see a nation guided by veterans’ leadership and courage, then I’m asking you to send in whatever you can to help me fight off these attacks!
---
I am in one of the **TOUGHEST** races in the country this year and I’ll need every good conservative in my corner if I’m going to win this thing. Look, I flipped this seat red in 2022 and I will **NOT** let some Leftist take it back. **[Every day I try to live up to the legacy of the brave American soldiers who invaded Normandy. 3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61171> , Rep. Mary Peltola "walked away when

"hush money" trial."

very simple question: do you support Donald Trump, the Republican
presidential nominee, being convicted on trumped-up charges? Mary
Peltola's answer should be even simpler: 'no.'" She went on to say,

party. We all know that if it was a Democrat presidential candidate
facing jail time, she would be begging to get in front of the camera.
But because it's Donald Trump, she feels like she can turn a blind eye.
Alaskans support President Trump and the rule of law, not banana
republic behavior."

name: John Fetterman
subject: I get asked about my tattoos a lot
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
As we observe another Gun Violence Awareness Month, I’ve been taking some time to remember those we’ve tragically lost to gun violence.
#
Derek,
As we observe another Gun Violence Awareness Month, I’ve been taking some time to remember those we’ve tragically lost to gun violence.
I get asked about my tattoos a lot — on my right arm I have nine different dates. These are the dates when people were killed while I served as mayor of Braddock, starting in 2005. **Seven out of nine were gun deaths.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240607?refcode=em20240607-9085&refcode2=9085_434096_nRZSdY&akid=9085%2E434096%2EnRZSdY)
In a close-knit community like Braddock, it’s very likely that you know the victim and their family. It’s an incredibly wrenching and personal experience as a mayor — **but nothing compared to what the families have to go through.**
That’s why I’m committed to doing everything I can to prevent more gun violence in the future. We have the power to stop it — we just have to summon the will to get it done.
**[Derek, if you’re with me in this fight, will you make a $5 donation to my campaign today? As someone with a proud “F” rating from the NRA, I need your help to take them on.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240607?refcode=em20240607-9085&refcode2=9085_434096_nRZSdY&akid=9085%2E434096%2EnRZSdY)**

Thanks,
❤️ John

body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466678/477966331/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, The Owyhee Canyonlands is Oregon’s last great unprotected natural treasure, and it deserves protection before it’s too late! [73% of Oregonians (and nearly 50,000 petition signers and hundreds of businesses, organizations, and community groups)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466679/477966339/835257482?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) support an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. With the 118th anniversary of the Antiquities Act coming up on June 8th, now is the perfect time for our Senators to get on board and help us call on President Biden for an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument! [**Will you send the message to Senators Wyden and Merkely today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466680/477966341/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466681/477966342/-1005412785?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)What is the Antiquities Act? Thanks to the Antiquities Act, U.S. Presidents have the ability to designate national monuments for federal lands and waters with scientific, historical, and/or cultural significance. This anniversary reminds us of the importance of national monuments for providing more equitable access to nature and strengthening biodiversity and wildlife habitat amidst a rapidly changing climate, and the Owyhee Canyonlands fits the bill. Congress also has the opportunity to permanently protect the Owyhee Canyonlands by passing [Senator Wyden’s Malheur Community Empowerment for the Owyhee Act (S 1890)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466682/477966343/-1443505139?emci=e272bfc3-969f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=fa4d5fba-38a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=1246005&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=), which is also supported by Senator Merkley. Senator Wyden has repeatedly led efforts to protect the Owyhee, but everytime Congress has failed to act. We thank Senators Wyden and Merkley for their leadership, and ask them to join 73% of Oregonians in supporting an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument and ask President Biden to make the designation. Today, only 5% of the Owyhee Canyonlands are protected and the threats of industrial development and climate change are clawing at its edges. 1.1 million acres would be protected from these threats with an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. The Owyhee Canyonlands represents one of the country’s single greatest opportunities for conservation in the West. **[Email our Senators today to encourage them to work with the Biden Administration to establish an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466684/477966345/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** President Biden has already used the Antiquities Act 10 times during his tenure to expand, designate, or restore national monuments. And the numbers don’t lie: Oregonians want to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands. **[Make the Owyhee Canyonlands the next National Monument by asking for the support of our Senators today!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86466686/477966347/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDJhMjY2LWU5MjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=opz8CqULOGjTBzGX0_cEEhZxLlbe7QRtthd0BGYGOzY=&emci=b70d84da-7f23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b442a266-e924-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** Sincerely, Eliza Walton

clean_body: | | | Peter, The Owyhee Canyonlands is Oregon’s last great unprotected natural treasure, and it deserves protection before it’s too late! support an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. With the 118th anniversary of the Antiquities Act coming up on June 8th, now is the perfect time for our Senators to get on board and help us call on President Biden for an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument! is the Antiquities Act? Thanks to the Antiquities Act, U.S. Presidents have the ability to designate national monuments for federal lands and waters with scientific, historical, and/or cultural significance. This anniversary reminds us of the importance of national monuments for providing more equitable access to nature and strengthening biodiversity and wildlife habitat amidst a rapidly changing climate, and the Owyhee Canyonlands fits the bill. Congress also has the opportunity to permanently protect the Owyhee Canyonlands by passing =, which is also supported by Senator Merkley. Senator Wyden has repeatedly led efforts to protect the Owyhee, but everytime Congress has failed to act. We thank Senators Wyden and Merkley for their leadership, and ask them to join 73% of Oregonians in supporting an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument and ask President Biden to make the designation. Today, only 5% of the Owyhee Canyonlands are protected and the threats of industrial development and climate change are clawing at its edges. 1.1 million acres would be protected from these threats with an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. The Owyhee Canyonlands represents one of the country’s single greatest opportunities for conservation in the West. President Biden has already used the Antiquities Act 10 times during his tenure to expand, designate, or restore national monuments. And the numbers don’t lie: Oregonians want to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands. Last week, Donald Trump was convicted of 34 felony counts of falsification of business records right here in New York.

Friend,
As the intensity of the campaign grows, we wanted to highlight Vicente's focus on putting the needs of South Texas first.
CHOICE 1: ✅ As a member of a bipartisan congressional task force to combat Mexican drug cartels, Vicente has worked across the aisle to achieve real results for the safety and prosperity of our community our community.
Vicente also supported crucial measures like capping insulin prices to make healthcare more affordable and backed the bipartisan infrastructure bill to improve our roads, bridges, and public services, all critical efforts to benefit everyone in our communities.
CHOICE 2: ❌ On the other hand, his opponent consistently follows the orders of a former president with a criminal record, voting against the interests of our community.
Vicente's opponent supports letting pharmaceutical companies price-gouge insulin—pricing out families from life-saving medication—and stood against the bipartisan infrastructure improvements that are essential for South Texas' growth and safety.
Friend, the choice for Texas' 34th Congressional District is clear— we don't want an opponent who prioritizes extreme partisan agendas over our well-being. So, will you help us show out-of-district MAGA extremists that la gente stands with Vicente, who fights for the real needs of South Texas by signing your name? [https://forms.oneswitchboard.com/vicente4tx/support-vicente-gonzalez]
SHOW YOUR SUPPORT [https://forms.oneswitchboard.com/vicente4tx/support-vicente-gonzalez]
With gratitude,
Team Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://forms.oneswitchboard.com/vicente4tx/support-vicente-gonzalez [https://forms.oneswitchboard.com/vicente4tx/support-vicente-gonzalez]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Our Next National Park
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Chiricahua
#

Hi everybody, Mark Kelly here. Wanted to talk to you about our National Parks, if you have a minute.
When Teddy Roosevelt created them, the concept was pretty new. At the height of the Industrial Revolution, conservation and preservation weren’t big priorities. Looking back, he was really on to something.
Today, our National Parks are some of our greatest treasures. They’re the heritage of every American — something we all can be proud of, that we all have equal rights to. And in my opinion, it’s something we should keep doing.
That’s why I have a bill for a new National Park: Chiricahua, down in Southeast Arizona. It’s an incredibly unique place, with its own history, plant and animal life, and dramatic rock formations. It deserves the protections that come with a National Park designation.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-natlpark-pet//?source=em240607-1-90&refcode2=5779.6688874.4NQ4BE&akid=5779%2E6688874%2E4NQ4BE)
My bill passed in the Senate in 2022, but it didn’t receive a vote in the House. I reintroduced it last year, but it didn't get a Senate vote.
I want to move this through, so I’m coming to you. [**Please: Add your name here, and tell Congress to make Chiricahua our next National Park.](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-natlpark-pet//?source=em240607-1-90&refcode2=5779.6688874.4NQ4BE&akid=5779%2E6688874%2E4NQ4BE)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-natlpark-pet//?source=em240607-1-90&refcode2=5779.6688874.4NQ4BE&akid=5779%2E6688874%2E4NQ4BE)**
Thank you so much for joining me.
Mark Kelly

Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.markkelly.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=5779%2E6688874%2E4NQ4BE).
Mark Kelly was a Captain in the U.S. Navy and astronaut. Friends, a quick note here from me.
I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won.
That terrible, terrible feeling. We didn’t know exactly what would come next, but we knew it would be bad.
Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th.
Do not, ever, let anyone tell you that elections do not matter.
I wake up every day ready to do whatever I can to defeat Kari Lake, Trump’s “MAGA Queen.” She’s dangerous enough on her own, but if she and Trump both win in Arizona this year, we’re all in big trouble.
The work we do between now and November is going to make all the difference on Election Day, and we have to make the most of each day.
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. Consider it an act of hope — hope that we can continue the progress we’ve made over the last few years, and that we can stop folks like Trump and Lake from gaining any more power and influence.

When I go on the debate stage on Sunday, I intend to let everyone watching know that my opponent...
1. Encouraged violence against President Trump live on MSNBC

2. **_Spent more than $5 million with the political fundraising firm owned by the daughter of the judge who just presided over President Trump’s sham show trial,_**

In a state that voted for Donald Trump by double digits in both 2016 and 2020, voters need to know the truth about the two-faced politico who pretends to represent their interests in Washington.

name: John Avlon
subject: Screw conventional wisdom. This is what I believe.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonissues [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonissues]

Friends, most of the time in politics, they tell you NOT to share where you stand on the issues. The conventional wisdom goes like this: It's a bad move to give your opponents anything to hit you on. So try to avoid it, right? Dodge and weave and avoid taking a stand.

That’s not me. I believe you have to tell people where you stand and make the case. Maybe if you're no-show Nick LaLota you have to avoid the issues because you're on the wrong side of Suffolk County voters with most of them. OK, that one makes sense to me.

But let's be really clear: I hosted "Reality Check" for years. I've written about major issues like how we have to defend women's reproductive freedom, protect Medicare and Medicaid, and lower costs for middle class families. I’ve even emceed a Planned Parenthood event. All that is to say where I stand on the issues is crystal clear and always has been.

So when I have my team put up JohnAvlon.com/issues, there aren't any surprises there. You know where I stand. And I'm proud of it. [https://www.johnavlon.com/issues]

Go click around to other candidates' so-called issues pages. They're full of empty platitudes if they exist at all. That's for cookie-cutter career politicians. When I say I'm running for Congress because Democrats have to win back this seat - it's because when I'm in Congress, Democrats are going to take meaningful action to combat climate change, take on price gougers, and defend abortion rights.
I'm proud of where I stand, because my values are Suffolk County values. I believe in helping veterans because that's what right. Same with expanding access to good public transportation, helping working families by restoring state and local tax deductions and expanding the child tax credit - and a whole host of other issues. The bottom line is pretty simple: What I'm running to represent in Congress are our community's values.

So why run from that?

Thanks for fighting the good fight with me.

-John

Peter — I’d like to talk about the stakes for our democracy in this election. [I hope you’ll take just a few minutes to read this important message and then chip in, if you can, to help me defend our democracy as AZ-01’s next Congressman.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86472695/477987228/-1561725702?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240607_AM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDg2OGIwOTQtZjMyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TM8J4JjjPfHgcHkCS4ugzBPl4exgtmLk-P_zfmodPUY=) As the grandson of four Holocaust survivors and son of refugees from communism, democracy and freedom aren’t abstract to me. They’ve always been real. I’m running for Congress because our democracy is under threat like never before, and the very values that define us as Americans — freedom, justice, and equality — are being tested. That became clear on January 6th, when my opponent, David Schweikert, and other extremists attempted to overturn a free and fair election — an act that shook the very foundations of our nation. We cannot allow a person who voted to undermine our democracy or has fought for decades to take away abortion rights to continue making decisions that will determine the course of our nation for generations to come. I’ve seen the price my grandparents and parents paid when freedom and democracy disappeared, and I’ll be damned if I’m going to let that happen to my children. **So this campaign is about more than flipping a seat for the Democrats — it’s about ensuring our children inherit a country where justice, truth, and freedom prevail.** I’ve served our country in uniform, and I’m committed to doing everything I can in Congress to protect our democracy from those who wish to tear it down and support democracy across the globe. | | Peter,

Congressman Mike Thompson here – contacting you about two upcoming events happening on **_June 22nd._**

As you might know, I chair the Gun Violence Prevention task force that was established in 2012 and I recently became the chair of the Congressional Bike Caucus. Because both of these causes are so important to me, for the past seven years, I have supported a local community event called **Rock the Ride.**

Rock the Ride is a bike ride and walk for the community to take action about gun violence prevention. It’s a great way to get the community organized for a critical issue and get active together.
**_[Click here to learn more and register for the ride/walk!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86472600/477987112/-12907531?refcode=EM_NBI_MT_20240606_INV_RTR_0_3MO_MikeThompson_NA_NA_RocktheRide4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTY4YjA5NC1mMzI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cZv5qhkDyHKQFLLTDF9Wdf5g5-yYYmiY_ncfau3-TUc=&emci=43e32eb6-7823-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=4a68b094-f324-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2678920)_**
This year, we will be having a burritos and bubbles brunch following the ride, with special guests **Peter Stetina** , a local cycling legend, **Chris Cosentino,** chef, author, and cyclist, and **Marianne Martin** , who won the very first Tour de France Féminin in 1984, a race that ran alongside the Tour de France.

Rock the Ride will be taking place in the morning in Yountville and **later that same day we’re having a special reception with Marianne at the Walt Wines tasting room in downtown Napa.**

This is a rare opportunity to hear firsthand from the pioneer who shattered barriers and made history by claiming victory in one of cycling's most grueling and revered events, so I hope you will join me!

I hope to see you on **Saturday, June 22nd!**

\- Mike Thompson

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Hi Peter, it’s Helene — Kirsten’s daughter.
I told my mom I wanted to reach out today because it’s Gun Violence Awareness Day.
Like so many people my age, this is an issue that hits really close to home.
I’ll never forget when my school went into lockdown. There were reports of a person with a gun on school property, and I didn’t know what was going to happen. I remember calling my mom and feeling absolutely terrified.
I was lucky that day. But for too many kids in schools, movie theaters, shopping malls, bowling alleys, and churches, that hasn’t been the case.
I know one of my mom’s top priorities in Congress will be passing common-sense gun safety laws; laws that create universal background checks, end the gun show loophole, ban assault weapons, and keep us safer in our communities.
I’m so proud to have a mom running to make a better Arizona. This is an incredibly competitive district — but she knows it’s worth the fight.
This race is a toss-up, so every dollar makes a difference. You can help her campaign flip AZ-06 blue this November by donating here >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_060724_GunViolence_act]

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| [**SOCIALIST MAYHEM**](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8bee0ff8a4eb410c83b1123708de99fc&_e=rgyt84m7lCooWc12MUavpgt6e7Uek6HeMrw_fuYTlwfiB710JwsM6pbitUP_CpekrPwE_55CWd6VcfJJPuzL3QSh6iNNpWsqzzOJ6Rxayix52K1sIaje1TXjkAYTPsGNUhJ7i2cEPEHOpPpIO4x_HIqjSb9aa_wa27aWCYWLEK45pZ3-7_Wyy2Z1ArCcLiFLj2sjvmxLPuWdWqF93QpoT50eel1PoTVr30p7Pxshdi9dDj3Err8A87Ay8_rXV2Xsair1HHsmzxPRh8eUpGZFqRaadvNsxTHP2-7UvwOFh7WgnGW4l4_cKp0_chSn_8KZkTnYDY0ImYb7SgKjY9YEO6sMjxRsmckFyUo_pLwzkOuugGi1Rw19jkqbFP8_6GE63EcsX1kZ9fFbbrSqCYu_Sg%3D%3D)

****[**Help me keep the House RED. The results of this election will seal our fate. We don’t have time to take chances.**](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8bee0ff8a4eb410c83b1123708de99fc&_e=rgyt84m7lCooWc12MUavpgt6e7Uek6HeMrw_fuYTlwfiB710JwsM6pbitUP_CpekrPwE_55CWd6VcfJJPuzL3QSh6iNNpWsqzzOJ6Rxayix52K1sIaje1TXjkAYTPsGNUhJ7i2cEPEHOpPpIO4x_HIqjSb9aa_wa27aWCYWLEK45pZ3-7_Wyy2Z1ArCcLiFLPJrXxKW5sGs5-_MkCeqBLptpMGdweh6piw7FeisFTTkn6BEUCXmPLXpJXhBwKulhfab0zfdtWnXRiPliOGARMnz2HseRcUGoaw62BbDXogp_OTbsA1XnYK2ChpPTMXp7Zqnx-To5bu2To9mBlvSto-71LSiEiWqBsCIXin2ZapbzeGSJPjlX5A57UkXbpQBNr3XNaTvOWiz2u1qVUzIbAQ%3D%3D)****

_Congressman Wesley Hunt_

| | | Peter - President Donald Trump's favorite columnist and Fox News contributor, Deroy Murdock, [wrote a column](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=0fde2c7870&e=fc26432468) comparing and contrasting the GOP primary field in the race for Congress in Nevada's crucial 3rd district. After a deep dive into all the candidates, Murdock concluded,
---
| **"Drew Johnson is a towering sunflower in a field of weeds. His opponents are staggeringly wrong for the job.

Johnson is the only credible conservative in his district and might be NV-3’s only sane Republican candidate.

Johnson has identified some $60 billion in taxpayer-funded boondoggles, cut taxes, launched education-choice programs, and expanded charter schools."**
---
| Murdock follows by encouraging President Trump to endorse Drew!

He also points out flaws with Drew's challengers for Congress:

**Dan Schwartz** ➡️
"While he was state treasurer, **Schwartz tried to impose a corporate income tax** — and failed. He also has advocated a 25-cent per-receipt food and drink tax, an airport-arrival levy, and — perfect for Sin City — a gambling tax hike. **Like most socialists, Schwartz sees healthcare as an “economic right.”** He also **praises Biden’s student-loan/taxpayer bailout scheme."**

**Elizabeth Helgelien** ➡️
As a state senator, "stories surfaced in the state capital of Elizabeth allegedly having affairs with lobbyists, staffers, and even several other lawmakers ... Helgelien kept screwing up, even while dressed. **She bragged about MBA studies when she lacked a BA.** She blew off legislative meetings, failed to return committee leaders’ phone calls, and went AWOL when it mattered. **Her erotic activity and parliamentary inactivity finally forced her to resign."**

**Marty O'Donnell** ➡️
"In a likely first for a GOP primary contender, **O’Donnell applauded Senator Bernie Sanders (Socialist - Vermont) as he ran for president** on May 23, 2016. 'I never thought I would feel such affection for a crotchety old socialist,' O’Donnell wrote via X (then Twitter). The next day, **he added: 'I love what he’s doing for the Democrat party.'"**

Murdock highlights Drew's commitment to fighting the outrageous political witch hunts by the Biden administration that have turned our sacred justice system into a laughing stock:
---
| **"I have been a government watchdog for 25 years," Johnson said.

"I have fought corruption and forced crooked officials out of office. If elected, I will take those skills to Congress and expose political witch hunts, election fraud, and the weaponization of our justice system so no American will suffer what President Trump has endured virtually every day since Obama-Biden’s FBI spied on his campaign in 2016.”**
---
| Read Deroy Murdock's entire column [here](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=b74e1948ba&e=fc26432468).

**Don't forget, Election Day is next Tuesday, June 11. Please vote Drew Johnson for Congress! **

I might be running to serve California in Congress, but that doesn’t mean I will slow down on furthering my legislative work on behalf of Californians.

Every day in office it’s my mission to deliver progress, for Californians and for our environment. I'm proud to share just a few of my efforts to protect our state’s wildlife and their habitats. These bills that I authored recently passed the Assembly:
* **The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889)** enhances wildlife connectivity and prioritizes corridors to allow our biodiversity to thrive, allowing us to thrive. Wildlife connectivity corridors protect both human and animal life by providing protected spaces for animals to migrate, and reducing traffic collisions and other unwanted interactions.

* **Wetlands: State Policy (AB 2875)** protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from a recent Supreme Court decision which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Now, California can hold the line against this rogue court. Our wetlands are critical habitat for our state's native species. They are not for sale.

* **Pesticides: anticoagulant rodenticides (AB 2252)** expands rat poison restrictions to include a class of toxic poisons which kill thousands of non-target wildlife and pets. These rodenticides, still available for purchase, were widely criticized after a photo of our beloved P-22 emerged, showing him with mange linked to rodenticides, which kill through internal hemorrhaging. There is no reason to continue the use of rodenticides when less lethal alternatives are available

It is an honor to shepherd these bills out of the Assembly, and you have my word that I will work tirelessly until my final day to ensure they become law.

And as your Congresswoman, you can guarantee I will take this spirit of strong, California-first policy like this national, and always put your safety ahead of easy short-cuts.

clean_body: | = Friend, I might be running to serve California in Congress, but that doesn’t mean I will slow down on furthering my legislative work on behalf of Californians. Every day in office it’s my mission to deliver progress, for Californians and for our environment. I'm proud to share just a few of my efforts to protect our state’s wildlife and their habitats. These bills that I authored recently passed the Assembly: The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889) enhances wildlife connectivity and prioritizes corridors to allow our biodiversity to thrive, allowing us to thrive. Wildlife connectivity corridors protect both human and animal life by providing protected spaces for animals to migrate, and reducing traffic collisions and other unwanted interactions. Wetlands: State Policy (AB 2875) protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from a recent Supreme Court decision which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Now, California can hold the line against this rogue court. Our wetlands are critical habitat for our state's native species. They are not for sale. Pesticides: anticoagulant rodenticides (AB 2252) expands rat poison restrictions to include a class of toxic poisons which kill thousands of non-target wildlife and pets. These rodenticides, still available for purchase, were widely criticized after a photo of our beloved P-22 emerged, showing him with mange linked to rodenticides, which kill through internal hemorrhaging. There is no reason to continue the use of rodenticides when less lethal alternatives are available It is an honor to shepherd these bills out of the Assembly, and you have my word that I will work tirelessly until my final day to ensure they become law. body:
We are bringing as many people into the fold as possible because when people see our vision and understand our policies, we will win in November. | | | | [ ](https://SRCOMM.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b15308cf5f888e47b0c8aa13d&id=2ee3b388c0&e=701cbbe14f)
---
| | | **A Message from Caroleene**
---
|
---
| Throughout May, we worked hard to spread our conservative message to every community, group, and voter in District 2. From participating in the christening of Austal's Pierre (LCS 38) in Mobile and welcoming American Idol's Triston Harper home in McIntosh to visiting the Uriah Cotton Patch Festival and celebrating our law enforcement officers during National Police Week, we are bringing as many people into the fold as possible. I believe that when people hear our plan, see our vision, and understand our policies, we will win in November.

In every conversation I have, there is a consistent theme: hardworking families cannot afford a Democratic majority — not at the grocery store, not at the gas pump, and especially not at our southern border. It is clear that we cannot give Joe Biden and the Democrats another vote for open borders, inflation, and weakness on the world stage.

As I work daily to encourage others to join us in fighting for Alabama families and growing the majority, I thank each of you for your continued support and prayers.

I hope to see you on the campaign trail soon!

Sincerely,
Caroleene Dobson
---
|
---
| | NEW ENDORSEMENTS
---
|
---
| **Congresswoman Elise Stefanik's E-PAC** Last month, I was honored to be endorsed by Congresswoman Elise Stefanik’s (R-NY) E-PAC. Congresswoman Stefanik has defended traditional values, but she needs more conservatives standing alongside her in Congress. I appreciate the confidence and support that E-PAC and Congresswoman Stefanik have placed in my candidacy for Alabama's Second Congressional District, and I stand ready to join her in our ongoing battle.

I am excited to be in D.C. next week for the official announcement of the endorsement as we prepare to maintain control of the House and put a Republican back in the White House.

subject: Notes From Paul...SERVICE: The Heart of Government
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Buskirk for Congress campaign
body:
| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5f8565f8cf52/how-can-i-help-the-campaign-12694625?e=a3f26a61c6)
---
| Last week, I embarked on an extended trip across both the central and southwest parts of our 1st District!
**Salina/Saline County** My hosts set up a meet-up time at the local coffee shop where local colleagues stopped by to share and listen. The afternoon included recording a podcast interview for future use at the local radio station. Later we stopped by the home of the parents of two now-all-grown-up daughters with whom I had the opportunity to work in my education role 20 years ago. Great fun to hear stories about their grandchildren! And finally, the local democrats hosted a picnic near the train park. I always appreciate these opportunities to meet new friends and colleagues!
**Hutchinson/Reno County** During my time in Hutchinson, I was able to meet with several individuals during the day. I listened to concerns about housing, poverty, and access to medical care, in particular. Over the lunch hour, my host indicated that we had the opportunity to visit with a dozen or so colleagues. He told me “We’ll meet them at the airport for the buffet!” (I’ll offer that I’m not sure I had ever heard the words ‘airport’ and ‘buffet’ used in the same sentence before that day. And yet I have to say, the noon buffet at that steakhouse was amazing!) That evening the local democrats gathered in Carey Park for the Reno County Democrats' annual Taco Bowl gathering, where local candidates were introduced and given an opportunity to speak and share their thoughts.
---
| **Dodge City/Ford County** Dodge City is where I launched my campaign in November 2023. This was my 3rd visit to that community. The local democrats hosted a meet and greet gathering in the late afternoon. Prior to the event, I was able to visit again with a few members of the local United Food & Commercial Workers who are taking classes in citizenship. They are such a delight. The pride they take in becoming U.S. citizens and new voters is truly inspiring!
**Garden City/Finney County** My last stop in this swing was Garden City for the Beef Empire Days celebration! I was able to participate in the Saturday morning parade! My first parade since the Derby high school band marched at the Kansas State Fair in 1976! What a delight to meet all the joy-filled children and their families along the parade route! The parade is only a small part of this long-standing tradition of celebrating the Beef industry in this area, complete with many community events including a rodeo, the parade, and a chuckwagon-style lunch and music in Stevens Park on Main Street. So many aspects of the Beef industry are vital to numerous communities in the Southwest corner of Kansas, as well as across the 1st District. What a great celebration of this community and the beef industry!
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| As I continue to travel and talk with people across the district, I am reminded of what is at the heart of this campaign. **SERVICE**. _**Service is the heart of government.**_ Service is what our communities – our district – expect from those we send to Washington to represent us. While I do believe that many of our representatives were originally sincere, I believe that these same elected officials have lost their way. Our government needs to be reminded of its purpose: Serving the people to meet their needs.
At each stop along my travels, I am reminded of the passion behind my desire to serve. Across our District, we are, **MANY voices. ONE passion. UNITED to provide a legacy for our children.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| | ****Boeing On The Brink Of Disaster 🚨****
---
| |
---
A few weeks back, I told you I was fired up about this year’s [Boeing incidents](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=411743c50ec54ccca96dda43efaa7f53&_e=cL5A30EUJC60fB2q59cPMz3qc7gLpXXW0pAeS_oReXMlqV_lfzbVBKiGfPn3D_LRrr_YZLGB_AXy_gDnvIkAqO8Z4JLWtW4wslW6he5GJnJf52VMy6EOI20SKGu0zY8WT3ma-ERACG7OODvAtpJbpWKDYKhXwigKPHtL2lsU3QpCGKzUSNFOlS14kj7kvaaSoAKQuFNvhmyTjW29fU-Jn3jhBj8Ak-Zrkr-4GjL3Hd4HtWi-_dzro6YsmeLzgyoRnBlciKRsaH9_fMwF5S42xHo5mPKk1cEn-jha5qvineL-OCMSPBENJRCNAF8KxYgw) and the total lack of accountability we’re seeing. I’m still fighting tooth and nail to get to the bottom of it, so I wanted to give you a quick update. Earlier this week, we had a closed-door meeting on the Transportation Committee—why it had to be closed-door, I’m still not sure. But either way, these knuckleheads are telling us that it’s all about basic economics. They say it’s cheaper and easier to have parts made overseas, so dadgummit, that’s what they’re doing. Everybody talks big about “Made in America,” but when push comes to shove, the big boys don’t care. For them, it’s all about the bottom line. But these aren’t everyday products where quality is the only concern—this is a matter of [life and death](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=411743c50ec54ccca96dda43efaa7f53&_e=cL5A30EUJC60fB2q59cPM4x2K99HtYCxWBymRzcYu-W_aOJ3B17sdITiWRnPyL0V6zGOaqdQJqELgmdcZY4B8G24oogBOWGgEkvvRT7-6P__0EX8UHREDX2p-h132BCunsh2ZVyLpsdebkvHNRFDz4yZkpdYA3X9g-1IM-SHwxKuMxVs_gwF68RgrohkdZOMWS6gdSRQ7vrvZBibd-QXs0ZaG1Im_41T6m0GcGBf7np77VOWkKRlOptjKmIpFpUYkpbE4CctjhWRfly7bZJOG8s_u65gZUu6feikV11eR44%3D). We can’t have Boeing putting profits over safety, folks. As someone who flies at least twice a week, this whole thing scares the living daylights out of me, and I know countless other Americans agree. So, what can we do? How can both parties come together on some economic policies that will help Boeing makes its stuff right here in the USA? That’s exactly what we’re trying to hash out in these meetings, and while it’s only the beginning, we better work quickly. Whistleblowers keep coming forward—and their [claims](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=411743c50ec54ccca96dda43efaa7f53&_e=cL5A30EUJC60fB2q59cPM4x2K99HtYCxWBymRzcYu-XwE2hb4dhBEmbZwcWGXstQ57AS77fyT3IkFCsIIX5QQz6isl4b58Tvuv8k1p9HwOt6h_Z7QIiF_baM4UPkDFWDPtI03t5henYfLY_OWB6HVFJu0OnCeJj5TUGEz_FnvusJdyHYaA5bX9BKu9zLHzSMxy1td1p-MsKeaStdubxQUQBT5BYnPEXd7TB91aGyWPpi8OvgXLKzXhERvvKW0zfntF4nkn-agfMIWb9m7hN4jL5mla_zB6gaRzFkBapHf9k%3D) are damning. One said his bosses would pressure him to keep safety reports to a minimum because they didn’t have _time_ to fix mistakes. This brave man said, and I quote, “Everything I was seeing was like a ticking time bomb.” If that doesn’t send chills down your spine, I don’t know what will. But here’s my promise to you: I’ll keep speaking out and digging for answers. I refuse to sit back while a corporation like Boeing [dodges responsibility](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=411743c50ec54ccca96dda43efaa7f53&_e=cL5A30EUJC60fB2q59cPM89r61Gka6g6XfGdM14b9ZCeDsDdK5K1QU9yFFJrTgqZaNZq1p8l6_XhqE8AbikBG5pVYy_efXaBJ4Kr7mGGqrKeRi8tipaDacQiGi7OuHg1imNepq3NgCsKyT8VETB3PXR0B_siORfdxrrtxOmspZLMhBVvCBxv7vIid-o4hSvdC8_2-dxcyYIFPOCS6Xv443CvQc3Po-dqnO90CvsrV1szXMsHb1sBeFE9J4ff-pBMJN4zK_HHoVimEJT3WmE27T03ooj_XYcVFkyUxwBUQfkDJ4F6FgoRPeFij44R82TE). This thing isn’t going to blow over; I’m ready to see it through to the very end until we know Americans can feel safe flying the friendly skies.
---
| | |
---
| | **Remembering D-Day 🪖**
---
| |
---
| | This week marks the 80th anniversary of the D-Day invasion, a pivotal moment that turned the tide in World War II. As I've shared before, my Uncle Roy bravely served during that time and died in Normandy just two weeks after D-Day. He sacrificed his life for the freedoms we cherish in America—and I think about it every time I look up at the flag that draped his casket, which is hanging in my office. When I left the Capitol building yesterday, I saw protesters exercising their constitutional rights. It was an important reminder of how people in other countries can only dream of such freedoms—freedom of expression, freedom of religion, the right to bear arms, and so much more. We are privileged to live in the greatest country in the world, and we owe it all to those who fought and died for it. They made the ultimate sacrifice, and the best way to honor their memory is to preserve the freedoms for which they gave their lives.

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | **Boeing On The Brink Of Disaster 🚨 | | A few weeks back, I told you I was fired up about this year’s and the total lack of accountability we’re seeing. I’m still fighting tooth and nail to get to the bottom of it, so I wanted to give you a quick update. Earlier this week, we had a closed-door meeting on the Transportation Committee—why it had to be closed-door, I’m still not sure. But either way, these knuckleheads are telling us that it’s all about basic economics. They say it’s cheaper and easier to have parts made overseas, so dadgummit, that’s what they’re doing. Everybody talks big about “Made in America,” but when push comes to shove, the big boys don’t care. For them, it’s all about the bottom line. But these aren’t everyday products where quality is the only concern—this is a matter of . We can’t have Boeing putting profits over safety, folks. As someone who flies at least twice a week, this whole thing scares the living daylights out of me, and I know countless other Americans agree. So, what can we do? How can both parties come together on some economic policies that will help Boeing makes its stuff right here in the USA? That’s exactly what we’re trying to hash out in these meetings, and while it’s only the beginning, we better work quickly. Whistleblowers keep coming forward—and their are damning. One said his bosses would pressure him to keep safety reports to a minimum because they didn’t have time to fix mistakes. This brave man said, and I quote, “Everything I was seeing was like a ticking time bomb.” If that doesn’t send chills down your spine, I don’t know what will. But here’s my promise to you: I’ll keep speaking out and digging for answers. I refuse to sit back while a corporation like Boeing . This thing isn’t going to blow over; I’m ready to see it through to the very end until we know Americans can feel safe flying the friendly skies. | | | | | Remembering D-Day 🪖 | | | | This week marks the 80th anniversary of the D-Day invasion, a pivotal moment that turned the tide in World War II. As I've shared before, my Uncle Roy bravely served during that time and died in Normandy just two weeks after D-Day. He sacrificed his life for the freedoms we cherish in America—and I think about it every time I look up at the flag that draped his casket, which is hanging in my office. When I left the Capitol building yesterday, I saw protesters exercising their constitutional rights. It was an important reminder of how people in other countries can only dream of such freedoms—freedom of expression, freedom of religion, the right to bear arms, and so much more. We are privileged to live in the greatest country in the world, and we owe it all to those who fought and died for it. # To honor freedom is to honor diversity.

As a teacher in middle school, high school, a medium security mens prison and most recently for more than three decades at Coke University, I've seen a lot of diversity in my classrooms. I'd like to think that I provided a safe environment to all of my students, no matter their race, gender identity or sexual preference. I assisted, in a faculty advisory role as 90s-era Coker students organized diversity student group. Today, Coker University has a Center for Diversity, Interfaith and Inclusion.
The truth is, along the way, I learned as much from my students about diversity as I was ever able to teach them. That and my upbringing in Los Angeles guided me to an awareness and a core value: that everyone deserves dignity.
That's just common sense, and I believe, for the common good. See, I believe that our country derives its strength from our diversity. Anti-gay and anti-trans bigotry weakens us, and when I'm in Congress, I'll work hard to strengthen this country, and repel what weakens us.
When I am in Congress, I will advocate for legislation that protects and preserves dignity and equality concerning sexual orientation and gender identity. The LGBTQ community deserves full recognition and support regarding personal expression, marriage, family planning, medical care, and legal protection.
Ultimately, to honor freedom is to honor diversity. It would be my honor if you could join me in the fight to defend it.
— Mal

Friend,

It's Wesley Hunt.

As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I'm running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=32ac32b5d5be46adb283d120ff6c3b1f&_e=7IGRy4FSRXzEz1x2xbhIyWzqiJmPw8lK6RYD8Kup9uVDeBdx4pHpWwl1xrAvJD_cZnqytHNpH5P3eJbubraS0xb5XQE17tXspA5ghNYye1LTupHbHwbeHdln-lAEvMjJ9En9v853CK9yA7Kvx2G4UkKpuGpqkJDmt8kavxAer9mtJhTwrUn2D0EV5KNCUjNsMiIwAZWg4P37ktdFjWsNTAIHbeOFndwA78j4T5cUvIMrbiYdUgEIYgPfqbzgqYNZurF4g9m8huJdD9aHKcaP7wdSkSmYInU5WX2EoBgAqdU%3D)_(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
